tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan gu ru mahā badz+ra dha ra mañju gho ṣa dharmā swā mī na mā mi/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun gyi de nyid spros pa dang bral thugs tshud nas/ /kun la bu gcig lta bur dgongs pa'i thugs rje can/ /kun khyab 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dang / /kun tu dbyer med khro dbang gshin rje'i tshogs la 'dud/ /lha mchog gang gi zab yangs dam chos mdzod kyi sgo/ /kho bos legs bshad rin chen lde mig 'dis phye nas/ /rnam mang brgyud pa las 'ongs chos tshul kun rig pa'i/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung ming don ldan pa'i bstan bcos 'di/ /sngon byon gong ma'i bstan pa spel ba'i mdzad 'phrin la/ /snying nas dad pa'i rjes su yi rang cher skyes shing / /da dung bstan dang 'gro la cung zad phan re nas/ /bsam pa dag pas bshad la don gnyer dga' bas nyon/ /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir khro bo'i dbang po dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'chad pa la/ spyi 'di'i sa bcad don tshan so so'i snying po rnams bsdus pa'i legs bshad nyung ngu zhig brtsams na blo dman rnams la mkho bar snang yang / 'dir don tshan so so ma 'dres par yongs rdzogs bris pa'i dgos pa ni/ rje bla ma gong ma de dag gi gsung rgyun ngo mtshar can rnams kyi tshig zur tshun kyang ma nyams par/ rjes 'jug rnam dpyod can rnams kyis mthong ba'i tshe dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa chen po 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i phyir yi ge'i dka' tshegs ma skyung bar bris pa yin pas blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzad 'tshal lo/

/'on kyang las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ don tshan 'di dag gi snying po 'dus pa'i legs bshad nyung ngu zhig logs su 'chad par bdag spro'o/ /don gnyis te/ gsung rab gzhan las 'byung tshul bshad pa dang / khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ chos rje tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ chos rje dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar/ /yongs su grags pa'i yongs 'dzin e wam̐ pa/ /kun mkhyen bla ma kun dga' bzang po zhes/ /bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag bstan pa'i bdag por 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i gsung la grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyis zin bris su btab pa'i gshed dmar gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul bshad pa'i gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi nang nas rgyud sde tshan zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams gtan la 'bebs par byed/ de'ang dmar nag gnyis su 'du zhing / nag po'i rgyud ni/ 'jam dpal sum khri drug stong gi nang nas phyung ba'i bsdus rgyud/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gshin rje dgra nag bshad pa'i rgyud gzhon nu gdong drug drag po mngon spyod kyi las gsal bar ston pa 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa rnams yin no/ /rgyud sde de dag rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na shin tu dar rgyas che zhing / bod du yang snga mor phebs la/ rwa skyo zhang gsum la sogs pa rnams kyis dar bar mdzad pa yin no/

/de lta bu'i rgyud sde de rnams dang mjal ba yang dal 'byor don yod par byas pa yin pas/ rnam gzhag zhib tu gshin rje'i gshed nag po nyid 'chad pa'i tshe rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor rnams ni sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje gdan du bdud btul ba'i tshe/ nyid kyi sku las gshin rje gshed dmar nag rnams su sprul nas bdud btul cing / lag na rdo rje la bka' bsgo ba mdzad de/ rgyud rnams gsungs so zhes gshin rje'i gshed pa rnams 'chad pas/ dmar nag gi rgyud rnams ni mnyam du byung ba yin la/ gangs can gyi khrod 'dir nag po'i skor rnams ni thog mar 'gyur la/ dmar po ni/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po zhes bya ba/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang thog mnyam pa/ na so bgres pa zhig gis bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta niska laṃ ka zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag gcig la/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dbang zhus nas/ rje btsun bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'khrul 'khor chung ba/ sus byas med pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchod chog byang chub snying pos mdzad pa'i 'phrul 'khor bri ba'i cho ga dus 'khor dang mthun par byas pa'i las tshogs rnams bsgyur/ dpyal lugs kyi dbang bka' 'di shin tu byin rlabs che/ 'phral du yang rgyal po'i gnod pa sogs la phan pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin te/ rje btsun rga lo la rgyal pos gnod pa la 'di byas pas grol ba'i gtam rgyud kyang yod/ lo tsā ba 'dis rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i gzhung dang bcu gsum ma'i bka' ma lon/ de'i rjes su chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal zhes bya ba/ dpyal las gzhon zhing / chos rje sa paṇa las cung bgres pa zhig gis bal yul du byon pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta niska laṃ ka ni gshegs/ de'i slob ma ra wen+t+ra bha dra zhes bya ba la/ lha lnga ma dang bcu gsum ma gnyis ka'i dbang zhus/

sngar dpyal gyis bsgyur ba'i gzhung rnams la 'gyur bcos dang / sngar ma 'gyur ba bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i gtor chog blo bzang snying pos byas pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i bskyed pa'i rim pa las tshogs dang bcas pa'i yig cha brgyad tsam 'gyur/ 'gyur shin tu legs/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tu spros med sogs ni sbas pa yin nam ma bsgyur/ mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhung zur du bkol nas gsungs pa'i rgyun da lta yang yod/ de'i rjes su chos rje pa'i slob dpon rtog ge pa dā na shī la byon nas/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po la lha lnga'i dbang gnang / sngar ma 'gyur ba'i gzhung 'phrul 'khor gyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bir+wa pas mdzad pa bsgyur/ de'i rjes la chos rje ba'i slob ma glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen zhes bya bas/ bal po ra wen+t+ra bha dra la bcu gsum ma'i dbang zhus/ phyis spu hrang gi sku mkhar nyi zungs su dar+pan a tsar+ya zhes bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta rig pa'i gnas lnga 'dzin pa'i slob dpon zhig dang mjal nas/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rdzogs rim rnams zhus/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang / bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i gzhung gyong se ba gcig bcu gsum ma'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung phran bco lnga tsam bsgyur/ de'i rjes su 'phags pa'i slob ma shong blo brtan zhes bya bas dmar po lha lnga ma dang bcu gsum ma gnyis ka ston pa'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa bsgyur/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la shrī zhes bya ba las lung blangs te ding sang gi bar du bzhugs pa yin/ de nas chag gis bsgyur ba'i bskyed rim gyi gzhung rnams la brten/ dā na shī las bsgyur ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyi 'phreng bas las tshogs gsal bar byas/

dpyal/ chag dā na shī la gsum ka las byung ba'i dbang bka' gsum dang / de dag gi steng du glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung rnams nyams su blangs par byas nas/ brgyud pa so so las brgyud pa'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i bstan pa bod na bzhugs/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa gcig kha chad tsam yin te/ dgra nag mkhas po gcig shes na le'u bcu dgu pa 'di 'chad shes pa yin no/ /dus phyis kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang po'i phyag tu rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa'i rgya dpe byung ba/ chos rje bu ston la bskur nas bsgyur bas da lta de'i dpe bzhugs/ rgyud rang gi ngo bo blo bzang snying po'i sgrub thabs dang / bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang sbyar la 'chad rgyu zhig 'dug de nas lha lnga kho na ston/ de'i lung da lta mi bzhugs pa lags/ de dbus kyi rgyud 'bum gsar pa rnams kyi nang na tshud yod/ gtsang na de'i dpe dkon/ de na rgyud sde gzhan na med pa'i rdzas kyi sbyor ba la brten pa'i las tshogs shin tu mang bar bzhugs/ rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa'i le'u dang po nas lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ brgyad pa nas bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor bstan no zhes pa de dag gis ni chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ zab yangs mdo rgyud bstan bcos ma lus kun/ /kun kyang mgrin pa'i lam nas spel mkhas mchog /mchog gi bla ma e wam̐ pa zhes grags/ /grags pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'di ngo mtshar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig ces bya ba las/ chos rje kun blo'i gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o// ༈ //gnyis pa chos rje tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/

rnam kun mchog ldan chos sku las 'ongs pa'i/ /rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung zin yab sras kyi/ /rnam mang gsung gi bdud rtsi spel ba la/ /rnam dpyod ldan rnams ci phyir gus mi bgyid/ /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa rgyal ba'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi brnyes pa bzang po'i zhabs dang / de'i thugs sras dam pa rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dam pa dpal ldan rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gung ru shes rab bzang po rnams kyi gsung rgyun bzhin bkod pa'i chos kyi rje tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul bshad pa'i gsung rab rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nyams khrid sku gsum lam byed kyi gdam ngag khyad par can zhes bya ba'i dbu na bzhugs pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba dang / grol byed kyi lam bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi don gtan la dbab pa la gnyis/ lam spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / bye brag tu bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos gnyis so/ /dang po la/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bal po thugs rje chen po zhes kyang zer/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po bha ro phyag rdum la gsan pa'i 'jigs byed rwa lugs dang / yang grub chen nā ro ta pa chen po nas rim par brgyud de/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags la/ sa chen kun dga' snying pos dngos su gsan pa'i 'jigs byed sa lugs dang / yang a mo gha badz+ra la/ zhang cog gru shes rab bla mas gsan pa'i 'jigs byed zhang lugs dang / yang paṇ+ḍi ta ba liṃ ta ā tsar+ya la/ mnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags kyis gsan pa'i 'jigs byed mnyos lugs dang /

a mo gha badz+ra chung ba la/ skyo 'od byung gis gsan pa'i 'jigs byed skyo lugs dang lnga po ni/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub thob rnams la dngos su gsan pa'i smin grol gyi lam rnam par dag pa yin la/ phyis kyi rgya ston pa dang / bu dge la sogs pa rnams kyi smin grol gyi lam gyi yig cha rnams ni rgya bod kyi dpe cha rnams las/ rang gi blo rnam par rtog pa la gang shar gyi legs bshad rnams bsdus par 'dod pas/ sngar bshad pa'i lugs lnga po 'di dang 'di yi rjes su 'brang bar yang khas mi len cing / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub 'di zhes pa la/ dngos su thob ces bya ba yang khas len rgyu med pas/ re zhig btang snyoms la bzhag par bya'o/ /dang po rwa ba'i lugs la yang / smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam bskyed rim dang / bsad las rgyas par bshad kyang / rdzogs rim gyi gzhung nyams su len tshul gsal bar ma bshad de/ kho rang gis mdzad pa'i dpe cha'i sdom tshig las/ lnga po gang rung legs bsgoms nas/ /bdun po gang rung bri bar bya/ /ha la'i shog dril rnam gsum yod/ /dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs 'dra yod/ /dka' 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'phen yod/ /nag 'grel phyogs mthong 'ben la gtad/ /me gsum gyis ni 'tshir bar bya/ /gsod pa'i mtshon de snying la gnas/ /ngas kyang chos rab khyod la gtad/ /khyod kyang de 'dra gcig la gtod/ /ces gsungs shing / me gsum ni/ sngags dang / 'phrul 'khor dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi me gsum gyis dgra bo 'tshir bar te/ bsad las bstan gyis/ rdzogs rim ston byed kyi gzhung ma bshad do/ /yang rwa pa'i lugs la/ rgya che ba la bslab pa/ zab pa la bslab pa/ zung 'jug la bslab pa dang gsum bshad pa'i dang po ni/ bskyed rim lha'i bsgom tshul dang / bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa la sems 'jog tshul la bshad la/ gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rim bsdus nas/ thig le nā da stong nyid la sems 'jog tshul tsam la bshad cing /

gsum pa ni/ stong nyid kyi ngang las lha skur langs te/ zung 'jug lha sku'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang / spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bshad kyi/ lugs 'di la rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa rgyas pa nyams su len tshul ma bshad do/ gnyis pa sa lugs la yang / rje sa chen gyis rtog bdun gyi ṭīk+ka mdzad pa'i rtog pa dang pos smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su bstan cing / dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dgra nag gi cho ga la kha 'phangs te shugs las bstan no/ /rtog pa gnyis pas 'phrul 'khor dang / rtog pa gsum pas sngags btu dang / rtog pa bzhi pas bskyed rim rgyas par bsgom tshul dang / rtog pa lnga pas lha zhal phyag mang bas/ de la dmigs pa mi gsal na ras bris kyi zhing bkod legs par bris te/ de la dmigs pa gtad nas bsgom tshul dang / rtog pa drug pas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rgyas par byed tshul bstan cing / rtog pa bdun pas/ ma he'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis bsam gtan gyi mthu las/ phrin las sna tshogs byed par bstan gyi/ rdzogs rim nyams len gyi dmigs pa rgyas par bshad pa med do/ /gsum pa zhang cog gru shes rab bla mas/ a mo gha badz+ra che ba la 'jigs byed bcu bdun ma'i dbang dang / bskyed rim las tshogs dang bcas pa rgyas par gsan yang / rdzogs rim ni ma byung ngo / /bzhi pa mnyos yon tan grags kyis/ ba liṃ ta ā tsar+ya la 'jigs byed lha dgu ma'i dbang dang / bskyed rim las tshogs dang bcas pa gsan yang / rdzogs rim nyams len gyi rim pa ma byung bar 'dug go /des na bod yul 'dir/ ding sang rdzogs rim nyams len gyi rim pa nyams su len tshul ni/ slob dpon a mo gha badz+ra chung ba rgya gar nas gtsang du phebs pa thos te/ skyo ston 'od byung gis mjal du phyin nas/ rang gi yul dbus kyi yar lung gra ma lung du gdan drangs te/

zhabs tog gya nom pa dang / gser la sogs pa'i 'bul ba rgya chen po byas nas/ gdams ngag khyad par can zhig gnang bar zhus pas/ bla mas khyod la chos ci dgos gsungs pa la/ jo sras kyis/ dgra gdong la sogs pa'i chos 'di rnams nged rang gi bla ma la thos pas/ da ni byang chub bsgrub pa la lam myur zhing zab pa'i nyams len zhig 'dod pas/ de dag la'ang gang 'thad pa zhig bla mas bstan par zhu zhus pas/ 'o na rdo rje 'jigs byed la yi dam gyis dang gsungs nas/ 'di gnang bas/ sta gon gyi nub mo rmi lam gyi skabs su byin rlabs khyad par can zhugs pa'i rtags kyang byung ba dang / bcu bdun ma'i dbang bskur ba'i ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'od byung ba/ jo sras kyi zhal du zhugs pas/ lus ngag yid gsum la nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes shing / bla ma'i zhal nas khyod la 'od byung ngam gsung ba la/ 'od byung lags zhus pas/ de tshun chad skyo ston 'od byung zhes grags shing / de nas bla mas grol lam bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag rdzogs par gnang zhing thugs nyams su bzhes so/ /des rang gi rigs sras skyo ston sku mched gnyis/ jo sras khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan/ gnyan 'od srung nas/ kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po'i bar du/ nyams len gyi rim pa rgyun ma chad par byung ngo / /rje de nyid kyis/ skyo lugs gzhir bzhag pa'i gsung bgros rnams tshwa ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris btab nas/ rje nyid la gzigs pa phul zhing zhu dag byas nas ding sang yang bka' 'bum gyi nang na bzhugs pa de yin la/ yang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / gzhon nu zla ba la sogs pa rgya gar ba'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung 'thor bu ba rnams las byung ba dang / dus phyis kyi chos rje'i gsung bgros khyad par can rnams la brten nas nyams su len par bya'o/ /de yang rang gzhan su yang rung ba'i/

'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang / bcu bdun ma dang / rwa pa'i bcu gsum ma dang / ro langs brgyad bskor dang / sa lugs kyi ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar dbang bskur ba thob cing / 'og nas 'byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bla ma la thob nas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de la kho bos ni/ 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang / rwa lugs kyi ro langs brgyad bskor dang / sa lugs kyi ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dkyil 'khor gsum du dbang bskur ba ni/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje ba'i drung du thob cing / rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i ṭīk+ka'i steng nas rtog bdun gyi rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dgag bsgrub rgyas par mdzad pa dang / 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid rnams ni/ sems dpa' chen po mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug gung ru shes rab bzang po gnyis ka la zhus shing thugs rjes bzung ngo / /zhes pa de dag gis ni chos rje tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan khro dbang dpal ldan gshin rje gshed/ /gang gi zab chos gang zhig byung ba'i tshul/ /brgyud ldan bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung gi bcud/ /'di 'dra thos pa 'di phyir skal ba bzang / /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig ces bya ba las/ chos rje tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung dri med rgyun/ /rgyun bzang spel la kun gyi 'gran bral gang / /gang zhig kun dga'i 'dren pa bzang po mchog

/mchog gi yon tan bsam bzhin lan brgyar 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa dpal ldan kun tu dga' ba'i 'dren pa bzang po gang gi gsung rgyun rnams chos kyi rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su btab pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul bshad pa'i gsung rab rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim rnam bshad smra ba ngan 'joms kyi dbur bzhugs pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi bka' stsal pa'i rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud la/ skye bo 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor dang / gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / zhe sdang can rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams so/ /phyi ma la gshin rje gshed dmar nag gnyis las nag po'i skor la rtsa ba'i rgyud dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud gdong drug dang / rtog bdun gnyis/ dang po la ni/ las thams cad sgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i rtog pa dang / rgyud sdom pa gsum pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /de rnams rtsa bshad yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgra nag dang por byung zhing / bshad gzhir gyur pa yin la/ gzhan gnyis phyis byung zhing / 'chad byed yin pas so/ /dang por byung ste/ ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kha ma'i tshe/ srod la bar chad med pa'i lam gyis bdud btul/ tho rangs rnam grol lam gyis sangs rgya ba'i tshe/ srod la bdud thams cad kyi 'tshe ba rab tu mang po byung ba la/ thugs ka nas khro bo'i rgyal po dgra nag sprul te/ phyag na rdo rje la/

phyag na rdo rje khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i gzugs su bsgyur te/ bdud dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang lha rnams choms shig chings shig rtogs shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes dgra nag gi tshogs rab tu mang por sprul te/ bdud rnams btul lo/ /de'i tshe phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dgra nag gi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /phyi ma gnyis 'chad byed du gyur pa ni/ gdong drug gis dgra nag gi gtor ma'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sogs pa/ cho ga'i rnam gzhag ma tshang ba kha skong bar byed pa dang / 'phrul 'khor gyi cha mi gsal ba gsal bar ston par byed pa dang / rtog bdun gyis drag po'i las mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pas bshad rgyud do/ /'o na rtog gsum dang / rtog pa gcig ma la sogs pa'i rgyud gzhan yang yod pa ma yin nam snyam na/ rtog gsum ni/ skyo ba rnams bshad rgyud du 'dod kyang / rgyud ma yin zhing / kho rang gi mgo gzhug gang na'ang rgyud yin zer ba med la/ de lta na yang / rgya gar ba'i a tsa ra gcig gis byas sam/ rgya gar ba'i man ngag yod pa'i bod gcig gis byas sam/ bka'i dgongs 'grel du 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos rnam dag gcig yin no/ /ra pas rtog gsum dgra nag gi bshad rgyud du 'dod de/ rwa lo chen po le'u bco brgyad kun gyi gzhi/ rgyud kyi rgyal por ston pas gsungs/ /de yi grogs su rtog pa gsum/ /sngags pa'i mtshon char ston pas gsungs/ /zhes bshad do/ /rtog pa gcig ma dang / 'khor lo'i rtog pa dang / gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang / gshin rje brang dmar gyi rtog pa zer ba sogs ni/ skyo lugs pa'i sngags pa kha cig gis rang dgar brtsams pa yin gyi bstan bcos rnam dag kyang ma yin no/ /las mkhan te'u lo'i rtog pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ rte'u lu pa'i pags pa blud pur bshus byas pa la brten nas/

gsus pa sbos pa'i man ngag gcig bshad pa/ rwa lugs pa kha cig gis phyung nas rte'u lo pa'i rtog pa zhes ming btags pa yin pas/ dka' las chung ba yin gyi/ rgyud rang rkang ba min no/ /des na gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor gyi rgyud bod du bsgyur ba la dgra gdong 'jigs gsum po 'dir nges so/ /'di la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / bod gangs can du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la rtsa ba'i rgyud dgra nag la/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba/ slob dpon shan ti pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon gzhon nu zla ba'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mthong ba'i lam gyi sgron me zhes bya ba 'o le ba gcig dang bzhi'o/ sgrub thabs grub chen la li tas mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes pa le'u gsum byas pas dang po sgrub thabs/ gnyis pas dkyil chog gsum pas las sbyor ston pa gcig dang / grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /gdong drug la/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon de ba a ka ra tsan tra'i sgrub thabs gnyis yod cing / rgyud de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi/ sgeg sogs brgyad de lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor ston cing / bsdu na lha dgu dang bcu gsum du yang bsdur rung ba dang bcas pa ston to/ /rtog bdun las/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa/ gzhon nu zla ba'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon rdo rje grub pa'i 'grel pa/ 'di la gzhung kha cig tu so na shrīs byas zer ba dang / kha cig tu/ dges pa'i rdo rjes byas zer ba dang / la lar mdzad byang med pa sha ba ri pas bsgyur/ nag tshos bsgyur zer ba rnams yod de/ don gyi ngo bo 'grel pa gcig nyid yin no/ /sgrub thabs kyi gzhung la/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang /

dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs sogs ji snyed cig yod do/ /gnyis pa bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su ni ma byung zhing / phyi dar gyi dus su/ cog gru shes rab bla ma zhes bya ba bod kyi rgyal po'i zhang rigs yin pas zhang zhes bya'o/ /des lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i smad la mnga' ris su byon te/ lo chen gyi grwa pa sgul phyi ru ba zhes pa gcig la/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang yo ga rnams bslabs la/ lo chen la chos 'brel yod tsam byas/ de nas rgya gar du byon te grub chen a mo gha badz+ra chung ba la gtugs nas/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka'/ dkyil chog gshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang / dgra nag la sgrub thabs de nyid dang / gdong drug la slob dpon de ba a ka ra tsan+t+ra'i sgrub thabs dang / 'jigs byed la grub chen la li ta'i sgrub thabs kyi steng nas gsan cing / rgyud gsum char la 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa legs po rnams gsan te bod du dar bar byas pa la/ dgra nag zhang lugs pa zhes grags shing / de nas skyo ba rnams la'ang brgyud de dar bar byas so/ /rje btsun 'brog gis/ dz+nyā na a ka ras sgrub thabs kyi 'gyur mdzad cing / khong pa nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed kyi chos skor byung yang da lta chad nas med yang 'gos kyis/ slob dpon shrī bha dra'i sgrub thabs bsgyur cing / de nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed kyi chos skor byung yang da lta chad nas med do/ /slob dpon shrī bha dra dang / khong pa'i bla ma nag po dam tshig rdo rje gcig par 'dug go /yang bla ma mnyos lo tsā bas rgya gar du byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta bha li ta a tsar+ya la/ bdag na so rgas pas chos mang po mi lobs shing / bod rnams kha gzan pas shin tu kha chod che ba/ mdo sngags thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pa gsang sngags yin pa gcig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/

gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gnang / de nas bdag gi dgon pa de la rtsa gcig na yod pas/ de bsrung ba'i phyir chos skyong zhig dgos zhus pas/ traka shad gnang / bla ma'i chos skyong 'di rtsub po zhig 'ong ba 'dra bas/ 'di gnon pa'i yi dam khro bo gcig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed gnang / de'i zhor la dgra nag dang gdong drug kyang gnang ste bod du 'jigs byed gnyos lugs zhes bya ba yang byung ngo / /da lta dgra nag dang gdong drug gi bka' chad cing / 'jigs byed de rnyed tsam yod pa 'dra'o/ /khong gi gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang dgra nag 'jigs byed gdong drug gsum la pha rgyud sde gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang bzhag go /yang bla ma mal lo tsā bas bal por bla ma haṃ ngu dkar po la grub chen nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor gsum gsan cing / de nas rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la brgyud de dar bar byas so/ /'di la dgra nag la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa'i steng nas bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dang / rgyud gzhan gnyis la 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i mchan gyi bshad pa rnon po dang / dbang bka' la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil chog dang / dgra nag la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / gzhan gnyis la rgyud kyi steng nas sgrub thabs man ngag gis ston pa mdzad do/ /rtog bdun rje sa chen gyi ṭīka 'jigs byed la rje btsun sku mched kyi bstod pa rnams yod do/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud 'di rnams 'jam dpal khri drug stong pa nas phyung zhes pa la/ rje btsun gong ma rnams/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa la brten nas 'jigs byed dang / mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /zhes pa la brten nas/ dgra nag dang / khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /zhes pa la brten nas/ gdong drug gi rgyud rnams 'phros par mdzad do/

/'o na dgra nag la zhal gsum yod pas zhal re re la spyan gsum yong bar rigs kyi/ spyan drug yod par mi 'thad do snyam na/ ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams/ spyan gnyis las med par shes byed 'god par mdzad pa dang mthun no/ /yang bla ma rwa lo tsā ba'i yul ni gnya' nam glang yul zhes bya ba yin la/ der bla ma rwa lo la khyim mtshes kyi chags sdang chen po byung nas/ bal por byon nas/ bla ma bha ro phyag sdum la/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum zhus te mkhas par bslabs nas gnya' nam du byon te khyim mtshes rnams tshar bcad de/ de'i tshe rong ban chen pos khong gi grags pa gsan te/ rong du spyan drangs te/ rong g.yung dbye dmar du bzhugs nas gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams dar bar mdzad de 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /bla ma des mdzad pa'i dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/ gsum char la sgrub thabs dkyil chog dgra nag gi ṭīk+ka dpe sna nyi shu tsam byas pa/ rtog bdun la nag 'grel zhes pa gzhung gi 'bru non pa tsam dang / de'i steng du dka' 'grel zhes pa nag 'grel gyi zhal shes rnams man ngag tu byas te der gsal du btang ba dang / de'i steng du bcud kyi thig le/ zhes pa/ man ngag shin tu zab pa zur du bkol ba dang / dkar chag tu/ gsod pa'i mtshon de snying la gnas/ /kha rgyun yi ger ma bkod do/ /zhes pa ni ha la'i shog ril nag po'o/ /gzhan yang lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs sogs lnga yod do/ /de la sogs te khong rang gi dkar chag tu thebs pa'i yig cha mang du yod do/ /yang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bla ma ldong ston shes rab dpal dang rgyas ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyi sgrub thabs ni/ rwa rgya ldong gsum grub mtha' gcig ces grags pa ltar rang lugs su 'du'o/ /gzhan yang bla mar ma do pas mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed mar do lugs zhes pa'ang 'dug go /yang bla ma cog glu shes rab bla mas rgya gar du lan gsum byon pa'i rjes ma la grub chen a mo gha chung ba bod du gdan drangs te/

'bring mtshams su phebs/ de'i tshe rus pa skyo yin pa'i/ khams pa jo sras sngar bla ma shes rab bla ma'i grwa pa yin pa gcig gis/ grub chen a mo gha la 'bul ba zhabs tog cher byas nas de nas grub chen gdan drangs te/ mar lam dpa' rnam phag pa ri'i 'dabs la pa tshab nyi lde zhes pa'i dgon pa yod pa der gdan drangs zhabs tog byas/ de nas khong rang gi dgon pa yar lung gi mda' gra ma lung zhes par gdan drangs te/ sngar bdag gi bla ma nas brgyud par gyur pa'i gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor rnams bla ma zhang shes rab bla ma la yang thob cing / da dung bdag la bla ma rang gi yi dam yin pa gang la thugs rtsis che ba gcig gi dbang bskur dang / de'i sgrub thabs dang las tshogs gcig kyang brtsams nas thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ 'o na bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar du spyod pa bsrung ba la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di shin tu bsngags shing / nga'i yi dam gyi mthil yang 'di yin gsungs nas 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gnang / de'i ye shes 'bebs pa'i dus bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od rdza ma tsam zhig byung nas/ slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam yod pa thams cad kyi mgo thog na phar yar 'gro mar 'gro byas pa'i mthar bla ma skyo jo sras kyi thugs kar thim mo/ /de nas khong pa la skyo 'od 'byung du grags so/ /de nas bla mas khong pa la/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs brtsams te gnang ngo / sngar gyi sems dpa' bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs de yang gnang ngo / /bla ma skyo 'di gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor 'di mtha' dag la mkhas kyang / de nas 'jigs byed kyi bka' babs pa lta bur song nas/ 'jigs byed skyo lugs zhes pa nyi zla ltar du grags so/ /gshin rje gshed dmar nag gnyis las rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan yan la/ nag po'i skor dgra gdong 'jigs gsum zhes pa ma gtogs dmar po'i skor ma 'gyur la/

phyis rting bla ma dpyal lo tsā bas/ bal po dza wen tra dpon slob gnyis dang mjal nas/ bla ma chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal bas ra wen tra la thug nas/ de man chad du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi nang nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa gtan la dbab par bya ba la/ bskyed pa'i 'di man chad gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor byung tshul rang du mi snang yang / rgyud dang sgrub thabs kyi don che rags thams cad dang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i gnad 'ga' zhig khongs su chud pa la phan pa'i phyir bris pa yin no/ /rim pa de rgyud las ji ltar bshad tshul dang / de bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams sus ji ltar bkral tshul lo/ /dang po la/ rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i rtog pa/ gnyis pa 'phrul 'khor gyi rtog pa/ gsum pa sngags btu ba/ bzhi pa lha bsgoms pa/ lnga pa bris sku/ drug pa sbyin sreg bdun pa bsam gtan gyi rtog pa rnams bshad pa las rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po'i bzhed pas/ rgyud kyi don 'di mdor bsdus na/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyis nyams su len tshul gsum bstan la/ de yang thun mong ba dang so so'i nyams len gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba rnams yin la/ de yang rtog pa dang por/ gzhal yas khang lha snam rim pa gcig dang bcas pa'i nang du/ le tshe dgu pa'i dbus su ro/ le tshe brgyad la mgo la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan brgyad dang / lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir gri gug la sogs pa 'god pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri bar bshad la/ de nyid kyi dbang bskur ba bstan to/ /rtog pa bzhi par/ bcom ldan 'das dbu dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi pa bsgom par bshad pas/ lha bsgom pa bstan la lha'i sku de nyid zhal phyag mang bas las dang po pa la dmigs pa mi gsal ba gsal bar bya ba'i phyir du/

rtog pa lnga par de nyid kyi bris sku 'bri tshul dang / dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa bstan pas/ de nyid lha bsgom pa'i cha lag tu 'gro ba yin no/ /de nas sngags bzla ba la bzlas bya'i sngags de nyid dag par bya ba'i phyir du/ rtog pa gsum par sngags bsdu ba'i cho ga dang / de dag gis bzlas pa'i tshad dang / bzlas bya'i yul gyi phreng ba rnams bstan la/ so so'i nyams len la/ dbang po rnon po'i nyams len ni/ de nas dbang po rnon pos bsam gtan tsam gyi sgo nas/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las rnams bsgrub par nus la/ de nyid kyi phyir bdun pa bsam gtan gyi rtog pa bstan to/ /de'i steng du dbang po 'bring pos/ 'phrul 'khor gyi sgo nas las bsgrub dgos la de nyid rtog pa gnyis pas bstan to/ /de'i steng du dbang po rtul pos sbyin sreg gi sgo nas las rnams grub par byed dgos pas rtog pa drug pa bstan to/ /dbang po shin tu rtul pos de rnams kyi sgo nas bsgrub par ma nus na/ gtor ma'i sgo nas bsgrubs pas mi 'grub mi srid pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la sgrub thabs spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bye brag tu gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di'i sgrub thabs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad bsdu na/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis su 'du la/ dang po la grub chen la li ta badz+ra gyi lugs kyi lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i sgrub thabs/ zhi khro sbrags ma'i zhi khro rnam par rol pa/ grub chen a mo gha'i lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba dang / rgyud dang 'grel pa thams cad kyi dngos bstan du gyur pa lha dgu ma'i sgrub thabs gsum mo/ /dang po ni rtog pa dang por/ gzhal yas khang lha snam rim pa gcig le tshe dgu dang bcas pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams su ro la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams dang / phyogs bzhi'i lha snam la/

gri gug la sogs pa drug drug 'god par bshad pa rnams lhar bsgyur la/ de yang / dang por 'jam dpal la sogs pa zhi ba bzhi bcu zhe dgu bskyed la/ de rnams phyag mtshan de dag 'dzin pa'i lha rdo rje mgo la sogs par bsgyur te/ khro bo bzhi bcu zhe dgur byed do/ /rgyud du phyogs re rer mtshan ma drug drug bkod nas/ lcags kyu la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje zhags pa la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /me thab la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /rlung gi ras la sogs pa bri bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi sogs khongs nas/ zhabs g.yas kyi 'og gi srog chags rnams ston te/ phyogs re res gnyis gnyis bsnon/ g.yon gyi 'og gi srog chags brgyad po sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir 'god do/ /'o na sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir ro langs brgyad 'god pa dang 'gal ba ma yin nam snyam na/ ro langs brgyad ni/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zur pa zhig bstan pa yin la/ 'dir ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag mtshan rnams dang / zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams lhar byas pa las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pas/ de las zur pa yin no/ /lha thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan mgo dang / lag pa la sogs pa dang / g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa yin no/ /'di'i bris sku rnying pa la lar phyag gnyis ka'i phyag mtshan mgo la sogs pa 'dzin par byas kyang / gzhung der lha thams cad kyi phyag na thod pa 'dzin pa'i dag pa bshad pas/ g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan mgo la sogs pa bsnams pa dang / phyag g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin par byed pa legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lha bcu bdun ma ni ye shes tshogs bsag gi rjes la/ thun mong gi srung 'khor dang / de'i nang du thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su mngon byang lnga las/ gshin rje gshed zhal drug pa phyag drug pa/

zhabs drug pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje ro langs ma de 'dra bas 'khyud pa bskyed nas/ mngal 'byin gyi sbyor bas/ ya ba ti dang / chos kyi rgyal po/ rtel pa/ glang mgo rje/ ral pa tshar dgu rmig pa/ phya sangs/ mig dmar te/ gshin rje pho brgyad rtsibs kyi phyogs mtshams su bkod/ dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa bsgom/ yang de'i dbus su mngon byang lnga las byung ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed dbu dgu phyag so bzhi pa bskyed/ sgo dang grwa rnams su/ sa bon las gshin rje pho nya mo dang / mche ba mo dang / be con nag mo dang / dus mtshan mo dang bzhi/ grwa bzhi dang sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma dang / zhags pa ma dang / lu gu brgyud dang / gshin rje 'bebs ma rnams bkod/ gong gi gshin rje gshed pho brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu bkod par gzhung der bshad/ skyo ba rnams kyi phyag len la/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bsgom/ grub chen a mo gha che bas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tu/ sgo dang grwa rnams su ro langs chen po brgyad dam/ gri gug brgyad bri bar bshad pa la/ skyo ba rnams na re/ 'di lha dgu ma dang bcu bdun ma gnyis ka'i dkyil chog thun mong ba yin te/ gri gug brgyad 'god pa ni gshin rje mo brgyad 'dzin pa yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ltar na rdo rje 'jigs byed la 'jig rten pa rnams kyis bskor ba'i lha bcu bdun ma'i brten pa ni/ 'phrul 'khor gyi rtog pa las/ drag po'i las sbyor byed pa la gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bsgrub bya la bsad pa'i las bsgrub par bshad pa la brten/ de yang nyi ma dang po la ya ba ti dang / phya sangs dang / gshin rje gshed lu gu brgyud ma dang / gshin rje 'bebs ma rnams kyis shar gyi sgor bsgrub bya mgo 'khor bar byed/ nyi ma gnyis pa la/ rtel ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po dang /

lcags kyu ma dang zhags pa ma ste/ gshin rje mo bzhis lho sgor khrag skyug par byed/ nyi ma gsum pa la nub sgor glang mgo can dang / smig pa can dang / pho nya mo dang / 'che ba mo ste/ gshin rje mo bzhis myos par byed/ nyi ma bzhi pa la byang sgor/ ral pa tshar dgu dang / mig dmar dang / nag mo dang / dus mtshan mo ste pho mo bzhis gsod par byed par bshad do/ /gsum pa lha dgu ma la/ rwa lo'i nag 'grel du/ ro langs brgyad ni/ ro langs kyi bsgrub pa byed na dgod pa yin gyi/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /zhes bshad/ rwa ba rnams kyi lag len khrigs bkod du/ sgo dang grwa bzhir ro langs chen po brgyad 'god cing / de thams cad kyang kha dog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sbar ba gyen du bgrad pa/ g.yon thur du bgrad pa/ zhal nas ha ha'i sgra sgrog par byed pa bsgom/ ro langs kyi bsgrub pa byed na/ ro langs rnams mgo gsum pa/ khog pa gsum pa/ lag pa gsum pa/ rkang pa gsum pa byed la/ rkang lag gnyis g.yon gnyis gnyis byas te/ lag pa gcig thugs kar bsnol ba/ rkang pa gcig gar stabs kyi tshul du bzhugs par byed do sogs kyis bshad pa bsdu ba yin gyi/ ma bshad pa bsdu rgyu med ces 'dod/ khong gis 'gyur de'i lugs la/ sgo dang mtshams bzhir ro langs chen po brgyad 'god do zhes pa 'byung bas/ sogs sgra la gzhan bsdu rgyu med kyang / de ni 'gyur ma dag pa yin te/ bla chen mal dang / zhes shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur du/ sgo bzhir ro langs chen po rnams 'god ces 'byung zhing / zom rong gi 'gyur sogs su/ sgor sgo dag tu ro langs rnams 'god ces 'byung bas so/ /zom rong na re/ sogs kyi skad dod la a ti zhes pa yod cing / de nyid dang po dang sogs gang du bsgyur kyang rung bas/ dang por bsgyur te/ lcags kyu dang por byas pas phyag mtshan drug dang por bri zhes sogs la 'bru gnon pa ni/

rgyud dang rgya gar gyi gzhung thams cad dang 'gal bas mi 'thad do/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs la/ sgo dang grwa bzhir ro langs chen po brgyad ni/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro bo'i gdong pa can g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin par bzhed/ de dang mthun par/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel par/ ro langs chen po brgyad ces gsungs pa ni/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ so rno ba/ nag po srin po lta bu/ gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa rnams so/ /'di dag gis sgrub pa po'i grogs su gyur pa/ 'dod pa'i las bsgrub pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /rgyud du lha rnams kyi phyogs rer mtshan ma drug drug bkod nas/ lcags kyu la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje zhags pa la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /me thab la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /rlung gi ras la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi sogs khong nas/ grwa bzhi'i ro langs rnams 'don no/ /de ltar na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la ro langs chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag mtshan rnams dang / zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams lhar byas pa bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dgu lhar byas pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis kyi bstod par/ zhal dgu'i rang bzhin lha dgu'i nyams dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dang / zhal gzhan brgyad po rnams 'khor ro langs rnams su byas pa yin pas 'di ni ches shin tu rnam par dag pa yin no/ /slob dpon a po'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs la bdag mdun gnyis ka la lha dgu bskyed/ de la bu ston rin po ches la li ta'i gzhung chung ba zhes pa'i ming btags so/ /'di ma gtogs lha dgu ma rnams kyi lugs la/ bdag bskyed la dpa' bo gcig pa dang /

mdun bskyed la lha dgu dang / rgyud nas bshad pa'i mtshan ma rnams 'god do/ /slob dpon a po ma gtogs bdag bskyed la phyag mtshan 'god pa med do/ /rin po che pas mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi dkyil chog yod pa ni gang gi lugs yin mi gsal yang / khyad par 'phags pa zhig yod cing der 'jigs byed la nang dbang byed pa mi 'thad de yum med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma la rgyud gzhan gyi 'khor phar bsre tshur bsre mi nyan zhes dgag pa'ang byas so/ /lo tsā ba rin rnam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su srung 'khor la thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsibs brgyad la gshin rje brgyad bkod/ dngos gzhi la/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das la ro langs chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor rwa lugs dang 'dra bar byas so/ /de ni mi 'thad de gang gi lugs su'ang mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /a mo gha'i lugs yin snyam na/ der rtsibs brgyad pa'i srung 'khor la gshin rje mo brgyad 'god pa yod kyang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su gshin rje mo brgyad 'god par bshad kyi ro langs brgyad 'god par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ rwa lugs yin no snyam na/ rwa lugs la/ 'jigs byed kyi skabs su thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor med pa'i phyir dang / bdag bskyed la'ang ro langs chen po brgyad 'god pa med pa'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /'o na rwa lugs la uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bzlog 'khor bshad do snyam na/ de ni gsang 'dus 'jam rdor ba'i man ngag paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa yin gyi/ 'jigs byed la de lta bu'i brda chad kyang med do/ /chos rje ri bo dge ldan pas/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs su/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor rtsibs bcu pa bsgom pa la/ rtsibs rnams su khro bo bcu bkod nas sngags kyang ci rigs pa bzla 'o zhes dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom zhing /

re mig dang lha snam la phyag mtshan 'god pa'ang ma bshad do/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ dpa' bo gcig pa dang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa rnams kyi lugs gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir te/ grub chen a mo gha'i lugs la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgoms pa yod kyang / khro bo bcu bsgom pa med cing / dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang / gshin rje mo brgyad bsgom pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon a bo'i lugs la thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor la khro bo bcu bsgom pa yod kyang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa lha snam rim pa gcig dbus le'u tshe dgu dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dang / sgo dang grwa rnams la ro langs chen po brgyad dang / re mig dang lha snam la phyag mtshan 'god par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gong gi de gnyis ma gtogs pa'i sgrub thabs gzhan rnams la ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgom pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bo dong 'jam ral gyi le tshe dang / lha snam gyi mtshan ma rnams lhar byas te/ sum cu so gsum dang / ro langs chen po brgyad de bzhi bcu zhe gcig tu byed pa mi 'thad de/ de ltar na/ re mig brgyad kyi mtshan ma rnams lhar byas pa'i lha dgu ma byas na yang / gnod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /yang mi tra brgya rtsar 'jigs byed lha dgu ma bshad pa dang / slob dpon rnam snang srung bas mdzad zer ba'i 'jigs byed lha lnga ma rnams kyang rang bzo las ma 'das pa yin no/ /bo dong 'jam ral gyis mi tra brgya rtsa kho rang gi byed lugs de ma shes pa yin te/ de'i lugs la rdo rje phreng ba sogs mdzad mkhan kho rang gis thob pa'i dbang bskur rnams kyi steng du/ rjes gnang thob pa rnams bsnan te brgya thams pa byas pa la/ 'jam ral gyis phag mo zhal gnyis ma dang don grub ma rnams la sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor byas so/

/lha zhe dgu ma la/ bod kyi skyo ba rnams dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs sa skya pa phyi ma rnams kyi yig cha dang / ro langs brgyad bskor ni rgyud kyi dngos bstan du byung bas/ rgya gar gyi sgrub thabs dang / bod kyi yang rwa ba sogs kyi yig cha mang po byung zhing / skyo ba rnams la a mo gha'i lugs kyi lha bcu bdun ma yod/ gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs la gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i nang du/ bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa dang / srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa rkyang pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa dang / srung 'khor dur khrod gang yang med pa pad nyi rkyang pa'i steng du bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa dang / gsum po der dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs ji snyed gcig yod pa rnams 'dus so/ /dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang dang por bskyed nas/ rjes su brten pa lha bskyed pa dang / rten dang brten pa gcig car du bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dz+nyā na a ka ra/ zhi ba ye shes/ las rgyal po/ pam tsi tsan+t+ra rnams kyi sgrub thabs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ shrī bha tra'i sgrub thabs/ bod kyi yang rje sa skya pa chen po'i bzhed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /de'i rjes su 'brangs te bod kyi bla ma rwa rdo rje grags kyi dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhal dgu rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba yod do/ /gzhan yang rwa lo'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang / zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste gsum yod cing / 'di gsum la bha ro'i gzhung gsum zhes pa yod ces zer/ bod du ma 'gyur/ gsum pa ni/ grub chen a mo ghas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /de ltar sgrub thabs rigs gnyis po de yang / rtog pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i rtog pa dang / bzhi pa lha bsgom pa'i rtog pa dang /

lnga pa bris sku'i rtog pa dang / gsum pa sngags btu ba'i rtog pa las sngags bslang ba sogs byas te thams cad bsdoms nas thon pa yin no/ /bla ma rwa lo tsā bas/ bal po thugs rje chen po'i man ngag yin zer ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dgra nag gi 'khor gyis kha bskang ba gcig gi gtso bo la yum dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen gter mdzod ces bya ba gcig mdzad/ gnyos pas/ bha ling ta a tsar+ya'i man ngag yin zer ba'i dgra nag gi sgo ba bzhi bor ba'i lha dgu ma gcig mdzad/ de la spyir gtso bo mi 'dra ba la 'khor 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor kyai rdo rje sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams kyi dkyil 'khor lta bu rnams dang / saṃ bu ṭi'i kyai rdor bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor rnams sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'gro ba sogs yod mod kyang / de rnams ni de ltar ston byed kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung tshad ldan yod la/ 'di gnyis la ni de ltar ston byed kyi rgya gar gyi 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung cung zad cig yod na/ rigs pa lta bur snang na'ang / de ltar du ston byed med pas the tshom gyi gzhir gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig na re/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma la/ rgyud rgya gzhung gi khungs gang yang med ces zer ba ni/ mthong rgya shin tu chung zhing / mthong ba'i don yang zhib tu ma rtogs bzhin du/ myur du kha tshon gcod pa la dga' ba yin te/ saṃ bu ṭi dang / rtog bdun gyi bris sku dang / lha'i rtog pa'i skabs su mi gsal yang / 'phrul 'khor gyi rtog pa'i skabs las shes te/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus pa'i skabs su/ srung 'khor byed tshul mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi rtog pa las/ rtsa ba'i sngags btus shing bgrangs nas/ sngags kyi yi ge bsre ba'i skabs su/

le tshe dgu pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ ya k+ṣe ma me da lnga bkod pa dang / de'i phyi rol re'u mig bcu gnyis pa la lhag ma brgyad dang / thod pa bzhi ste bcu gnyis kyi sa bon dgod par gsungs pa la/ de yang dgra nag las/ yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /yi ge ma ni phra mar gsungs/ /yi ge me ni 'dod chags nyid/ /yi ge da ni phrag dog 'gyur/ /gshin rje 'joms pa lnga ru grags/ /yi ge ya ni tho bar grags/ /yi ge rtsa las dbyug pa gtso/ /lag na pad+ma ni yig las/ /yi ge ra ni ral grir ldan/ /yi ge dza ni sems mar brjod/ /yi ge sa ni phag mor grags/ /yi ge do las dbyangs can grags/ /yi ge ru las gau rir grags/ /ṇa yo ni ra mtshams bzhi ru/ /thod pa bzhi ru grags pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i yi ge bcu bdun gyi lha bcu gsum dang / thod pa bzhi ru gsungs pa la/ 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas las bsgrub pa'i skabs su yang / yi ge bcu bdun las lha'i rnam pa can bcu gsum dang / lha'i ngo bo thod pa bzhi bskyed pa la/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa bcug nas las bsgrub par grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi man ngag la brten nas mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi 'grel par dpal chen rdo rje grub pa dang / so na shrī gnyis kas mdzad pa las/ yi ge bcu bdun po de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgoms pa la/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis/ gshin rje gshed lha bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ mdun du rnam par bzhugs su gsol la/ mchod yon la sogs pa phul nas/ sngar bris pa'i 'khor lo la/ tho ba la sogs pa'i sbyor bas bcug la/ de nas las dang rjes su mthun pa'i rim pas bdag nyid rnam par bsgoms pa la/ sngags yongs su bzlas te/ las rab tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / 'jigs byed kyi dbang du mdzad pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi lha bcu gsum gyi las sgrub pa'i skabs su gtso bo la gshin rje gshed yong don med pas/

gtso bo 'jigs byed kyis mdzad dgos par gsal lo/ /de'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi skabs dang / 'phrul 'khor gyi lha 'god pa'i skabs su/ lha 'god pa'i gnas la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang / rgyud smin byed kyi sgrub thabs dang / las sbyor gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs kyi khyad par yin pas/ spyir gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis mdzad pa la 'khor dgra nag nas bshad pa'i lha bcu gnyis dang thod pa bzhis bskor ba yod pa shin tu gsal bas/ gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags pa dang / rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bod du srol phye ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs ni shin tu legs pas/ rgyud dang 'grel pa rnam par dag pa la brten pa'i lugs rnam par dag pa ma rtogs bzhin du skur pa gdab par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang khong rang gi lugs kyi rigs pa dang lung dang man ngag gi sgrub byed gsum byed par 'dug go /de la rig pa'i sgrub byed de mi 'thad de/ rtog gsum rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyud du mi 'thad pa'i phyir te/ rgya gar gyi 'grel pa 'thad ldan rnams dang / skyo pa ma gtogs bod snga ma rnams kyi lugs la/ rtog gsum rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyud du mi 'dod de/ rtog bdun gyi las bsgrub pa'i rtogs par/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor lo le tshe bcu drug pa/ bya rog chen po'i sgro rtse'i smyu gus sam/ mi'i rus pa'i smyu gus gcer bu skra bshig pas kha lhor bltas te ma he'i gdong gi sbyor bas bri bar bya'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i 'khor lo le tshe bcu drug pa de/ dgra nag las/ brgyad dang bcu gnyis bcu drug pa/ zhes pa'i bcu drug pa dang gcig tu 'chad pa'i phyir/ rwa lo'i lugs la rtog gsum khas mi len cing / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor lo le tshe bcu drug pa/ zhes pa'i don la snying po'i 'phrul 'khor/

nye snying / rtsa sngags/ snying po dang nye snying spel ba/ rtsa sngags dang snying po spel ba/ rtsa sngags dang nye snying spel ba/ gsum char bsdoms pa la 'phrul 'khor bdun te/ nag 'grel las/ bdun po gang rung legs bris la/ /lnga po gang rung legs bsgoms nas/ /gsum po gang rung bzla bar bya/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /de yang zlum po skor nyis sbrags la/ phyi ru re mig brgyad/ nang du brgyad de bcu drug gi dbus su dang / re mig rnams su/ rgyud las me gnyis kyi dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas pa bzhag la/ de la yi ge bcu pas bskor/ hūm̐ brgyad kyang bri/ zur du phaṭ bri/ zhes 'byung bas/ 'phrul 'khor gyi me chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi zur bzhir yi ge'i me raṃ re re/ phyogs su phaṭ re re/ dbus su che ge mo ma ra ya zhes pa la/ snying po'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ nye snying gis bskor ba dang / rtsa sngags/ re mig bcu drug po re re la yang tshogs brgyad po re res bskor ba ste/ tshar gnyis/ snying po nye snying bsdoms pa ni/ nang ma la snying po dang phyi ma la nye snying / rtsa sngags dang snying po bsdoms pa ni/ phyi ma la rtsa sngags/ nang ma la snying po/ rtsa sngags dang nye snying bsdoms pa ni/ phyi ma la rtsa sngags nang ma la nye snying / gsum char bsdoms pa ni phyi ma la rtsa sngags/ nang ma'i phyogs bzhir snying po/ mtshams bzhir nye snying gis bskor ba rnams bri/ ting nge 'dzin gyi me ni dmar po 'bar bar bsgom pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad rnams zhal las rtogs par bya'o/ /skyo pa rnams kyis/ rtog gsum rtog bdun gyi bshad rgyud du 'dod pa yin kyang / khyed 'dod pa ltar gyi lha bcu gsum ma khas mi len pas khyed kyi lugs de la mi phan no/ /spyir khyed kyi sgrub byed de la 'brel med de/ rtog gsum 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su yi ge bcu bdun bshad pa la/ dgra nag las yi ge bcu bdun lhar bskyed par bshad pas/

'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub byed du 'gro ba de lta na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed g.yas dbyug pa dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa sogs bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ gcig kyang byed rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor du ya k+ṣe ma me sogs kyi yi ge bcu bdun bshad la/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud du yang yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod ces sogs yi ge bcu bdun las lha rnams bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ yang dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed de la/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed/ g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa sogs kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gcig byed rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su yi ge bcu bdun 'god pa bshad cing / gdong drug gi rgyud du yang / yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces sogs yi ge bcu bdun po rnams las lha bcu bdun po bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir dang / 'jigs byed kyi dbang du byas pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi lha bcu gsum gyis las bsgrub pa'i skabs su/ gtso bo la gshin rje'i gshed gzhan yong don med par yang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / grub chen bi ru pa'i lugs kyi gshed dmar lha lnga de yang lha bcu gsum mar byed rigs par 'gyur te/ grub chen bi ru pas gshed dmar gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su/ ya k+ṣe ma me da sogs yi ge bcu bdun bshad la/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud du yi ge bcu bdun las lha rnams bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na gshed mar lha lnga mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /yang rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ phyogs skyong bco lngas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig kyang byed rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor du hriḥṣ+ṭi yi ge bco lnga po rnams bkod pas/

dgra nag tu yi ge bco lnga la phyogs skyong bco lnga bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ gsal pa khas len no/ /yang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ bdag med lha mo bco lngas bskor ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu drug gi dkyil 'khor gcig byed rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor la a li bcu drug 'god par bshad cing / brtag gnyis las/ a li dang po bdag med ma/ /zhes sogs a li dang po bco lnga las bdag med lha mo bco lnga bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ gal te de ni ma rgyud yin pas mi mtshungs so snyam na/ de lta na/ khyed rang gi 'jigs byed la yum yod pa'i sgrub byed du/ brtag gnyis kyi lung bkod pa la'ang mtshungs so/ /bye brag tu khyed kyi sgrub byed de la 'brel cung zad kyang med de/ 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su bkod pa'i yi ge yin na/ lha'i rnam par bskyed dgos pa'i nges pa med cing / dgra nag gi yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod ces sogs kyi yi ge de rnams/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs kyi lha bskyed pa'i sa bon yin pas/ ya yig sogs kyi yi ger mtshungs pa tsam yin gyi/ de gnyis phyogs mi gcig go /dang po grub ste/ a mo gha badz+ra gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su'ang yi ge nyid kyi rnam pas btson bsrung gi tshul du bkod par bshad pa'i phyir dang / gal te yi ge de ltar bskyed dgos na lha bcu bdun du 'gyur bas khyed rang gi khas blangs dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ lung gi sgrub byed de yang 'khrul te/ gong gi 'grel pa der/ yi ge bcu bdun po de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgom pa la/ zhes bshad kyi/ yi ge bcu bdun po de dag lha bcu gsum gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgom par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gal te thod pa bzhi bsnan pas lha bcu bdun du 'gyur ro snyam na/ de lta na/ gshed mar lha lnga dang / mahā ma ya lha lnga dang /

bde mchog lha lnga sogs kyang / lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba dang / bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma sogs kyang lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba sogs ha cang thal lo/ /don la gnas pa'i phyogs ni/ yi ge bcu bdun po de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgom zhes pa des/ grub chen a mo gha badz+ra gyis bzhed pa'i lha bcu bdun po de bstan pa yin no/ /man ngag gi sgrub byed de yang 'khrul te/ khyed 'dod pa ltar gyi lha bcu gsum ma 'di/ gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags kyis rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus pa'i man ngag yin zhes pa'ang / tshig tsam la yang rtog dpyod ma zhugs pa yin te/ gnyos pa'i lugs la lha bcu gsum ma med pa'i phyir dang / gtso bo la yang yum med pa'i phyir ro/ /rwa los lha bcu gsum mar 'dod kyang / bris sku la yum mi 'dod cing / dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la phyag mtshan 'god pa sogs bshad pas khyod kyi de dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir yang khyed kyi de/ rgyud rgya gzhung dang / bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma thams cad kyi bzhed pa dang 'gal ba yin te/ rgyud du/ lha snam rim pa gcig dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du le tshe dgu dang / lha snam la phyag mtshan 'god par gsungs la/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs re tsam ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la gzhal yas khang gi lha snam 'dod cing / lha snam dang le tshe rnams la mdun bskyed kyi skabs su phyag mtshan 'god pa/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma thams cad mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang khyed kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ yum yod pa la sgrub byed med cing gnod byed yod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sgrub byed med pa ma grub ste/ rtog bdun dang / sam bu ṭir yum dngos su gsal bar ma bshad pa bzhin du/ 'dir sgrub thabs mang por/

yum yod pa ma gsungs pa mang yang / yod par ma bshad pa dang / med par bshad pa gnyis don mi gcig pa'i phyir/ des na yum yod pa la dbang gong ma gnyis la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ a mo gha badz+ra'i dkyil chog las/ des na gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /zhes 'jigs byed la dbang gnyis pa dang gsum pa bskur bar bshad pa ltar shin tu yang dgos la/ de la gsang dbang la ni/ slob ma la nges pa med kyang / bla ma rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas yum la brten te gsang dbang gi rdzas bsgrub dgos la/ dbang gsum pa la ni/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas/ rig ma lha mor bskyed pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bo bskyed dgos pa la ni/ khungs thub kyi gzhung du ma yod do/ /de ltar yin na gtso bo la yum byung ba yin no/ /yum med par 'dod pa dang / sta gon gyi skabs su bla mas rang 'od kyi rigs ma sprul te/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras slob ma rnams rang gi lus la bcug rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar gnas pa la byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur ba'ang 'gal ba yin no/ /de ltar na bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba dang / gtso bo la yum med par 'dod pa ni ma dag pa chen po yin par shes par gyis shig de bzhin du dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la brten nas kyang grub bo/ /gsum pa kyai rdo rje la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ bla med kyi rim pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dgos pa mang du yod kyang / gtso bo ni rdzogs rim gyi rtog pa khyad par can skye ba'i rgyu smin byed du 'gro ba yin la/ de la ni rim pa dang po'i skabs su/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas drangs pa'i bde ba dang de kho na nyid kyi lta ba dang gnyis sbyar te rgyun ldan du bsgom dgos pa'i tshul rnams gzhan du rgyas par bshad zin pa ltar yin no/

/dpal 'dzin gyis/ 'khor lo rim pa dang po'i skabs su/ yum bsgom pa med na dgos pa de mi 'grub pas/ bskyed rim gyi gnad ma tshang bar 'gyur na/ 'dod par mi nus so/ /tshul de la dogs pa dpyod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs la shin tu gsal bar gsungs te/ kyai rdo rje las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /phyag rgya nyid ces ji ltar brjod/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya gnyis dag gis/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'dis/ phyag rgya la brten nas dngos grub 'grub par bshad pa la/ de ltar na bdag med ma gtso bor byas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis phyag rgya'i dngos grub mi thob ste/ rig ma bsgom pa med par phyag rgya'i dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang / rang gi phyag rgya ma gzhan gcig bsgoms na phyag rgya ma gnyis sbyar bas bde chen mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /des na de 'dra ba des phyag rgya'i dngos grub ji ltar thob par 'gyur zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur/ /kak+ko la dbus yang dag gnas/ /'gram gnyis dril bu dag tu 'gyur/ /ze'u 'bru bo la can du 'gyur/ /lhag ma bdag nyid chen po nyid/ /dga' chen he ru ka yi gzugs/ /zhes so/ /de 'dra ba la ni bud med de lha mo'i gzugs su bsgom pa spangs nas/ de las gzhan bcom ldan 'das te/ lha yab kyi gzugs su bsgom par gsungs so/ /de nas nu ma spangs nas/ bo la kak+ko la'i 'gram gnyis dril bu ste ze'u 'brur 'gyur zhes pa ni/ rten de'i steng nas don la de ltar 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/ dmigs pas de dag mi mngon par byas nas rdo rje sogs su bskyed pas so/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bdag med mas mdzad pa la bsgom pa'i tshe/ mo'i rtags bsgyur nas pho'i rtags dang ldan par bsgom par gsungs so/

/de yang mu tig phreng bar/ sme ma ni dkyil 'khor gyi bdag mo'i mgul nas khyud do/ /de las gzhan rnal 'byor ma bdun spros pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang rang gi pad+ma las byung ba'i rdo rje dang / sbyor bas bcom ldan 'das ma thams cad la yongs su spyod do/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bdun spros pa g.yung mo la bcug nas g.yung mo la rang gi pad+ma rdo rjer byas te longs spyod par gsungs pa ltar/ rtags bsgyur ba des phyag rgya ma gzhan la snyoms 'jug byed pa yin no/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lha mo gcig tu bshad pa la yang / sngar gyi dogs pa nges par bskyed dgos la/ de gcod pa la'ang yum yod pa'i lan gdab dgos kyi/ yum med kyang phyag rgya'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro zhes smrar mi rung bas/ kyai rdo rje la brten nas kyang shin tu 'grub bo/ /zhes gsung ngo / /de rnams ni rim pa bzhin du mi 'thad de/ dbang gong ma gnyis bskur dgos pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pas bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dus su'ang / yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can du bsgom dgos na/ slob dpon a bha yas/ phreng bar gsungs pa'i/ phag mo lha sum cu rtsa bdun ser mo dang / dmar mo dang / sngon mo dang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ rdo rje sgrol ma lha mo bcu gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le sogs/ yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor de rnams la bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dus su yang gtso mo la yab sbyor dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'dod na rnal 'byor bla med kyi yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor mi srid par 'gyur te/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs yin na dbang bzhi bskur dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang phreng bar bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la yang bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skabs su yum sbyar dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'dod na/ slob dpon a bh+yas/

bcom ldan 'das ni shes rab ma dang bral ba'o/ /zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed dgos pas kyang ma khyab ste/ grub chen mi thub zla bas/ bum dbang gi skabs su/ slob ma mi bskyod par bskyed pa des lus kyi dri ma dag par byas nas/ gsang dbang gi skabs su rnam snang du bskyed/ gsang dbang gi ngag gi dri ma dag pa de 'od dpag med du bskyed pa de la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / gsang dbang gi rdzas bsgrub pa la rnam pa kun tu dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal bzung nas bsgrub dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rjer/ rin 'byung gi nga rgyal gyis snyoms par 'jug de nas rdo rje 'chang du 'pho ba sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin byed kyi bskyed rim yin na/ yab yum zhal sbyor la brten nas skyes pa'i bde ba yin dgos na/ yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor legs par bsgoms kyang rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin byed du 'gyur ba mi srid pa sogs kyi skyon yod do/ /'dir ni skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyang gzhir byas nas/ de sbyong bar nus pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa sogs sgrub thabs kyi gzhung 'ga' rer bshad pa dang / bde ba rgyas pa'i rtags su liṅga dmar po gyen du langs pa bshad pa rnams kyang / rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin byed du 'gro bar mngon no/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ rgyud 'dir mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i grogs tsam ma gtogs/ phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub dngos su thob par byed pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa ma yin gyi drag las gtso bor bstan pa'i phyir te/ rtog pa gnyis par/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sbyor ba la gnas pas/

dang por re zhig sngags pas bsad par byas te/ rgyud 'di la sngags pa lha'i sbyor ba dang ldan pas/ thog mar ni byas te de'i sbyor ba gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta na yang / mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rtag tu mar me cher bza' zhing / /zhes pa la brten nas/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi gdam ngag dum pa zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /'o na yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang gong ma gnyis bskur ba'i tshe ji ltar byed ce na/ rang gi rigs bdag gang yin pa'i rigs bdag gi gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal du byas nas dbang bskur ba yin pas/ 'dir yang mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis bskur bas chog go /dper na rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su'ang / slob ma rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par mi bsgom par/ rigs lnga'i rnam par bsgom pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du sta gon gyi skabs su/ slob ma la nang dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi rigs pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog de bsgrub bya yin gyi/ sgrub byed ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i rigs pas kyang yum yod par mi 'gyur te/ gzhung de'i dgongs pa ni/ bud med kyi rten du gyur pa'i sgrub pa po gcig gis/ sa bcu pa thug gi bar du bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor gyis bsgrod nas/ nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe/ rang dang rtogs pa mnyam pa'i byang sems sa bcu pa gcig rnyed na/ de dang lhan cig tu nye rgyus mtshams sbyor bar byed/ ma rnyed na/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa can gyi pho'i gzugs su dngos su bsgyur nas/ phyag rgya ma gzhan dang snyoms par zhugs pas mtshams sbyor bar byed ces pa ston pa yin gyi/

nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ma ran pa'i las dang po pa'i dus su/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshe/ bud med kyi gzugs su bsgom pa spangs nas/ he ru ka'i gzugs su bsgom pa ston pa min te/ de nyid las/ 'bad pa med par skyes bur 'gyur/ /gsal bar nus pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de phyir phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mnga' bdag mai tri pas/ dbang bskur nges bstan du/ 'thob bya'i 'bras bu kha sbyor gyi yan lag dang ldan pa yin pas/ de thob byed kyi rgyu kha sbyor gyi rnam pa can dgos na/ de 'di la ji ltar rung zhe na/ 'di la kha sbyor gyi don tshang ba yin te/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gas yab mtshon pas thabs shes zung du 'jug pa yin no zhe na/ 'di yang mdzes pa ma yin te/ thabs shes zung du chud pa tsam pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang yod pa de las khyad par du 'phags par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang 'di la kha sbyor dang ldan pa yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na de yang mi 'thad de/ de ni grub pa'i dus su yin gyi sgrub par byed pa'i dus su ni ma yin no/ /zhes las dang po'i dus su yin pa bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /de las gzhan du khyed ltar na/ /bo la spangs pa nu mar 'gyur/ /dril bu 'gram gnyis dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes sogs su bsgyur dgos par yang 'gyur ro/ /'o na de'i tshe/ he ru ka dngos su bsgyur bas chog mod/ nye rgyus mtshams sbyar ba'i he ru ka'i rnam pa can gyi phor bsgyur ba'i don med do zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/ de'i tshe bud med kyi gzugs spangs nas/ pho'i gzugs su dngos su bsgyur nus kyi/ skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs kyi he ru kar ni nye rgyus mtshams ma sbyar bar bsgyur mi nus pa'i phyir/ pho'i gzugs su dngos su bsgyur ba'i nus pa yod pa tsam gyis/ he ru ka dngos su bsgyur ba'i nus pa yod dgos na ha cang thal lo/

/de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod pa la sgrub byed med pa yin no/ /der ma zad gnod byed kyang yod de/ khyod 'dod pa ltar gyi yum rdo rje ro langs ma de lta bu gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te dgra nag las gsungs pa 'dir len no snyam na/ dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i tshig gi cha len pa yin nam don gyi cha len pa yin/ dang po ltar na/ der rang 'dra'i yum bshad pas/ 'dir yang rang 'dra'i yum zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa gcig byed rigs par 'gyur/ don gyi cha len pa yin na/ yum zhal gsum phyag drug ma gcig byed rigs par 'gyur/ gal te gshed dmar nas bshad pa 'dir len no snyam na/ de ltar na yum dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gcig byed dgos pas/ khyod kyis sngon mor byas pa la 'brel med do/ /de ltar na khyod kyis/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod pa 'khrul pa gzhi med du song ngo / /gzhan yang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ yum rgyud dang rgya gzhung nas yod par ma bshad pa yin gyi/ med par bshad pa'ang med ces pa ma brtags pa yin gyi/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha'i rnal 'byor ston pa'i rgyud rgya gzhung thams cad du liṅga dmar po gyen du langs par bshad pas yum med par bstan pa yin te/ yum yod na liṅga yum gyi pad+mar nub pas phyi rol tu gyen la langs pa mthong ba mi 'thad pa'i phyir dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sogs bla med kyi lha yum dang bcas pa ji snyed cig yod pa rnams la/ liṅga gyen du langs pa 'di lta bu gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na yum med pa nyid rgyud dang rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung gi dgongs pa yin no/ /sgrub thabs spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa bshad zin to/ /zhes pa de dag gis ni/ chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bstan zin to//

//'dir smras pa/ bstan 'gro'i dpal gyur mkhas dbang kun gyis bsngags/ /bsngags 'os gang gi 'phrin las mkha' ltar khyab/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos ngur smrig 'dzin/ /'dzin ma'i rgyan de'i gsung bcud 'di ngo mtshar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba las chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// ༈ //bzhi pa chos rje dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ ma lus shes bya kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i phul/ /ma ltar kun la brtse ba'i sems dpa' che/ /ma dag 'khrul pa kun bral rdo rje 'dzin/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig rgyal gyur cig /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa nges don bstan pa'i srog shing rgyal ba mus pa chen po mtshungs med dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rgyun/ chos rje byams pa chos legs kyis legs par phye ste bstan pa bzhin bkod par mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa chos kyi rje sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid yig gi dbur bzhugs pas/ las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/ man ngag shes shing zang zing la ma chags pa/ snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing / nyung ngu'i don la mos shing / tshe blos thong zhing rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'dod pa'i slob ma dkri bar 'dod pas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs 'chi ba mi rtag pa sogs kyis blo bcos shing /

thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyis spro ba bskyed pa sogs/ blo ris dang bstun pa'i rang gi gang shes kyis slob ma la spro ba bskyed de/ 'dir rtsod med kyi grub chen bir+wa pas/ de yang blo dman pa dkri ba'i dbang du byas nas gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa gsungs/ dbang por rab dkri ba'i dbang du byas nas/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag 'di gsungs pa las/ da lan phyi ma'i sgo nas 'khrid pa la gnyis te/ smin par byed pa'i dbang dang / grol bar byed pa'i lam mo/ /dang po ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa la/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i dbang bskur ba rnam par dag pa thob pa ste/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pas shin tu gal che ba yin/ gnyis pa grol bar byed pa'i lam la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /'di lta bu'i chos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na/ theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'di theg pa chen po yin/ de la rgyu'i theg pa dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis las/ 'di 'bras bu'i theg pa yin/ de la phyi dang nang gi dbye ba yis/ /rgyud sde'i dbye ba'ang gnyis su gsungs/ /zhes rgyud sde gnyis su dbye ba'i tshul dang / /rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes rgyud sde gsum du dbye ba'i tshul dang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ sa skya pa rnams rgyud sde bzhi'i dbye ba bzhed pas/ de la rgyud sde gong ma rnal 'byor bla med la'ang thabs rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ gnyis med rgyud gsum las 'di thabs rgyud yin/ de la gdul bya'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum 'dul ba la dgongs te/

'dod chags can la dgongs nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor gsungs/ gti mug can la dgongs te rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor gsungs/ zhe sdang can la gtso bor dgongs te/ gshin rje gshed skor gsungs pa las/ 'di gshin rje gshed kyi skor yin/ de la dmar nag gnyis las 'di dmar po'i skor yin/ de la grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa la brten pa'i/ lha bcu gsum ma dang / slob dpon blo gros bzang pos le'u nyer gnyis pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i lha lnga ma dang / grub chen bir+wa pas u rgyan na bzhugs pa'i rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa la brten pa'i lha lnga ma dang gsum las/ 'di bir lugs yin/ 'di la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis yig cha du ma zhig mdzad na'ang / lha lnga char gyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa dang / gtso bo rkyang pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa dang / gtor ma'i cho ga ste bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / shin tu spros pa med pas de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rdo rje tshig rkang dang / 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang / bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga ste rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / 'phrul 'khor gyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba dang / gshin rje gshed bsgrub pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba las tshogs kyi gzhung gnyis te brgyad mdzad pa yin/ gzhung de rnams rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa las phyung ba zhes 'phrul 'khor gyi 'phreng ba las gsungs pas/ da lta bod na bzhugs pa'i le'u bcu dgu pa dang nyer gnyis pa la brten pa ma yin pas/ de rnams dang ma mthun yang 'gal ba med do/ /gong gi gzhung brgyad kyi dgongs pa nyams su len tshul la/ sgrub thabs bdud rtsi gsum pa/ lung sbyor bdud rtsi rol mtsho/ dbang chog bdud rtsi chu rgyun/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i 'khrid yig thor bu ba/ de'i lhan thabs spros med mdzes rgyan/ yig cha de rnams kyi steng du/ mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len/

bla ma dam pa'i man ngag rnams kyis brgyan pas/ nyams len shin tu zab pa zhig bzhugs pa yin/ 'di lta bu'i man ngag 'di/ bod du ji tsam nas byon na/ rje btsun rin po che'i sku tshe'i smad/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi sku ngo la/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos/ bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum sogs bsgyur cing / mang po la spel bas lugs 'di shin tu byin rlabs che bar grags/ yang chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis dpyal gyis bsgyur pa la 'gyur bcos mdzad/ 'phrul 'khor sngar ma 'gyur ba gcig sogs bsgyur pas 'gyur legs shing mkhas par grags so/ /de nas paṇ+ḍi ta da na shī las sus mdzad med pa'i gtor chog gi gzhung bzang po gcig la rang 'gyur mdzad/ gzhan yang chos rje sa paṇa sogs la 'phel te/ lugs 'di brgyud thag nye zhing / gdon thog tu bsngags pa yin/ de nas shong lo tsā bas kyang dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de nas mkhas grub bu ston rin po ches phyogs mtha' dag tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de nas rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams kyis dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ 'khrid bka' sogs dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de byin rlabs kyi rgyun deng sang gi bar du gnas pa yin no/ /zhes pa de dag gis ni chos rje dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ mchog gi bla ma dkon mchog mtshan can gyi/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi legs gsung chu bo'i rgyun/ /gang zhig su yis thos gang skal bzang ba'i/ /yon gnas 'di bshad phan yon dpag tu med/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba las/ chos rje dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// //de yan gyis spyi don dang po gsung rab gzhan las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas/

da ni spyi don gnyis pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa la gnyis te/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung rab dngos bshad pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i legs bshad bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyad par 'phags pa'i yongs 'dzin bla ma'i gsung / /khyad par 'phags pa'i sras kyis legs gsungs pa'i/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar gyis/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i bstan pa spel la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa yongs 'dzin dam pa kun gyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun rnams zin bris kyi tshul du/ de'i thugs sras rgyal tshab dam par gyur pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can du mas/ bstan 'dzin kun las mngon par du 'phags pa'i skyes chen dam pa sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bshad pa'i gsung bgros zin bris zhes bya ba'i gsung rab 'di gong du bkod pa'i dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam bshad de nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa lta bur snang yang gnyis ka rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zhig la zin bris mdzad pa po gnyis kyis rjes 'jug gi blo gros mchog dman la dgongs nas rgyas bsdus su mdzad par 'dug go /gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi don cung zad gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la gsum ste/ rgyud nas ji ltar gsung tshul/ de'i dgongs pa rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams kyis ji ltar bkral tshul/ de dag las bod kyi bla ma rnams gang gi rjes su 'brangs dpyad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud rtog pa bdun pa'i rtog pa dang po nas gzhal yas khang lha snam rim pa gcig dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ 'khor lo le dgu'i dbus su rdo rje dang /

gzhan le tshe brgyad la phyag mtshan brgyad dang / lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir phyag mtshan drug drug la sogs pa dang sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir ro langs brgyad dang bcas pa bshad/ yang de'i rtog pa bzhi par srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bcom ldan 'das zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa can ni dngos bstan la bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud de dag gi dgongs pa/ grub chen la li ta badz+ras gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dang / gzhan yang rgyud nas bshad pa'i phyag mtshan rnams phyag mtshan de dag 'dzin pa'i lha rdo rje mgo la sogs pa rnams dang / lha snam gyi phyogs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyi sogs khong nas zhabs g.yas kyi gdan rnams 'don te/ de 'ang phyogs re'i phyag mtshan gyi sogs khongs nas gdan gnyis bton nas/ de dag 'dzin pa'i lha dang / ro langs brgyad po ni rgyud nas bshad pa'i ro langs kyi sgrub pa byed na 'god pa yin gyi/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang / mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la ro langs mi 'god par/ de'i sar zhabs g.yon gyi gdan rnams bkod nas de dag 'dzin pa'i lhar bskyed de/ de ltar na lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang / yang slob dpon a bos gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dang ro langs rnams rgyud kyi rtog pa dang po'i dngos bstan ji lta ba bzhin te/ mdor na ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / yang slob dpon a mo gha badz+ra chung bas/ gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dang phyag mtshan rnams 'god pa rgyud kyi dngos bstan bzhin la ro langs rnams kyi tshab tu gnod sbyin mo brgyad dang / phyi'i pad+ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du gshin rje mo brgyad dang bcas pa ste/ mdor na lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor te/
