rgya gzhung nas dngos su bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor ni gsum po der nges so/ /gzhan dpa' bo gcig pa la/ slob dpon shrī bha dra dang / dz+nyā na a ka ra sogs kyis gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su dpa' bo gcig pa dang / yang slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis gzhal yas khang med pa'i srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig pa bshad/ a mo gha badz+ra la sogs pas gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod gang yang med pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'ang bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ bla ma rwa rdo rje grags kyis slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brangs te/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs zhal dgu rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba dang / lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo la yum dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen gter mdzod ces bya ba dang / gzhan yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang / phyag bzhi pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste lnga mdzad do/ /skyo pa rnams la/ la li ta'i lugs kyi lha zhe dgu ma dang / a mo gha badz+ra'i lugs kyi lha bcu bdun ma la sogs pa yod do/ gnyis pa rnams la lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'khor rnams la dgra nag nas kha bskangs pa gcig yod do/ /gzhan yang bod du lha zhe gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dod pa yang yod do/ /'di dag la 'thad mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa cung zad gcig byas na/ lha zhe gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ de ltar ston byed kyi rgyud rgya gzhung med pas rgya bod kyi mkhas pa su'i yang lugs ma yin la/ bod 'ga' zhig gi rang bzo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te rgya gzhung la la li ta'i lha zhe dgu ma'i rjes su 'brang ngo zhe na de dang mi mthun te/ de la lha zhe dgu yod pas so/ /yang gnyis pa'i lugs kyi lha dgu ma dang / rwa pa'i lha bcu gsum ma gnyis la yang / spyir gtso bo mi 'dra la 'khor 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor kyai rdo rje/

sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams kyi dkyil 'khor lta bu dang / sam pu tra'i kyai rdor lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor rnams sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor du 'gro ba sogs yod mod kyang / de rnams la ni de ltar ston byed kyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung yod la/ 'di gnyis la ni de 'dra med pas dpyad bya yin no gsung ngo / /'di la phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig na re/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma la ni rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi khungs gang yang med do zer ba ni/ mthong rgya shin tu chung zhing / mthong ba'i don yang zhib tu ma rtogs bzhin du myur du kha tshon gcod pa la dga' ba yin te/ sam pu ṭi dang rtog bdun gyi bris sku dang / lha'i rtog pa'i skabs su mi gsal yang / 'phrul 'khor gyi rtog pa'i skabs las shes te/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus pa'i skabs su 'phrul 'khor byed tshul mi gsal yang / gsal bar ston pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi bshad pa las/ rtsa ba'i sngags btus shing bgrangs nas sngags kyi yi ge bsre ba'i skabs su/ le tshe dgu pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ ya k+ṣe ma me da lnga 'god pa dang / de'i phyi rol re mig bcu gnyis pa la lhag ma brgyad dang thod pa bzhi ste bcu gnyis kyi sa bon 'god par gsungs la/ de yang dgra nag las/ yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /yi ge ma ni phra mar gsungs/ /yi ge me ni 'dod chags nyid/ /yi ge da ni phrag dog 'gyur/ /gshin rje 'joms pa lnga ru grags/ /yi ge ma ni tho bar grags/ /yi ge tsa las dbyug pa gtso/ /lag na pad ma ni yig las/ /yi ge da ni ral grir ldan/ /yi ge dza ni sems mar brjod/ /yi ge sa ni phag mor grags/ /yi ge do las dbyangs can grags/ /yi ge ri las gau rir grags/ /ṇa yo ni ra mtshams bzhi ru/ /thod pa bzhi ru bsgrag pa yin/ /zhes yi ge bcu bdun lha bcu gsum dang thod pa bzhi ru gsungs la/

'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas las bsgrub pa'i skabs su'ang / yi ge bcu bdun la lha'i rnam pa can bcu gsum dang lha'i ngo bo thod pa bzhir bskyed pa la/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas las bsgrub par/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi man ngag la brten nas mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa/ dpal chen rdo rje grub pa dang / so na shrī gnyis kas mdzad pa las/ yi ge bcu bdun po de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgoms la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gshin rje'i gshed lha bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ mdun du rnam par bzhugs su gsol la/ mchod yon la sogs pa phul nas/ sngar bris pa'i 'khor lo la/ tho ba la sogs pa'i sbyor bas bcug la/ de nas las dang rjes su mthun par bya ba'i rim pas bdag nyid rnam par bsgoms la sngags yongs su bzla 'o/ /las rab tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / 'jigs byed kyi dbang du mdzad pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi lha bcu bdun gyi las kun bsgrub pa'i skabs su/ gtso bo la gshin rje'i gshed gzhan yong don med pas 'jigs byed kyis mdzad dgos par gsal lo/ /de'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi skabs dang / 'phrul 'khor gyi lha 'god pa'i skabs su/ lha 'god pa'i gnas la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang / rgyud smin byed kyi sgrub thabs dang las sbyor gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs kyi khyad par yin pas/ spyir gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis mdzad pa las/ 'khor dgra nag nas bshad pa'i lha bcu gnyis dang / thod pa bzhis bskor ba shin tu gsal bas/ gnyis lo tsā ba yon tan grags dang / rwa rdo rje grags kyis bod du srol phye ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs ni shin tu legs pas/ rgyud dang 'grel pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la brten pa'i lugs rnam par dag pa ma rtogs bzhin du/

skur pa gdab par mi bya'o gsung ngo / /'di la yang dpyad par bya ste/ de la spyir gtso bo mi 'dra la/ 'khor 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor srid kyang / 'dir smos pa'i sgrub byed rnams kyis ni/ khyed 'dod pa ltar gyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor yod par mi 'grub ste rgyud rtog bdun dang / sam pu ṭi gnyis las/ de lta bu gsal bar ma bshad pa mthun snang du grub la/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su/ sa bon gyi yi ge bcu bdun 'god par bshad pas kyang lha bcu gsum mi 'grub ste/ spyir 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su bkod pa'i yi ge yin na/ lha'i rnam par byed dgos pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ a mo gha badz+ras 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su'ang / yi ge nyid kyi rnam pas btson srung gi tshul du bskor bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / gal te khyab na lha bcu bdun du 'gyur bas khyed rang gi khas blangs dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te gong gi yi ge de rnams lha bcu gsum dang / thod pa bzhi'i rnam pa can du gong du drangs pa'i khas blangs dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /dgra nag gi rgyud dang / rdo rje grub pa dang / so na shrīs mdzad pa'i rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa rnams kyis grub bo zhe na/ de rnams kyis mi 'grub ste/ dgra nag gi rgyud las dgra nag lha bcu gsum grub pas/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum grub pa'i shes byed med pa'i phyir dang / 'grel pa gnyis kyis kyang / lha bcu bdun bshad kyis bcu gsum ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu bdun bshad pas/ bcu gsum ma bshad par 'gyur ba ha cang thal lo/ /gzhan yang gong gi rgyud tshig des 'khor rnams dgra nag nas bshad pa'i lhar mi 'grub ste/ rgyud tshig de ni dgra nag gdong drug gshed dmar gsum ga'i rgyud na yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khyed 'dod pa ltar gyi bcu gsum ma 'di/ gnyis lo tsā ba yon tan grags dang /

rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta la dngos su zhus pa yin gsung yang gzigs rgya ha cang ches pa yin te/ gnyis pa'i lugs la lha bcu gsum ma mi srid pa'i phyir dang / gtso bo la yum med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gong gi 'grel pa gnyis kyis dgongs pa gang yin zhe na/ de ni lha bcu bdun ma'i las tshogs ston byed yin gyi/ lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub byed du 'brel med do/ /khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum 'dod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ yum yod pa la sgrub byed med cing / gnod byed yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la mkhas pa kha cig na re/ sgrub byed med pa ma grub ste/ de la rtog bdun dang / sam pu ṭir yum dngos su yod par ma bshad pa bzhin du/ 'di'i sgrub thabs mang por yang yum yod par ma bshad pa mang yang / yod par ma bshad pa dang / med par bshad pa don mi gcig cing / de dag gi lugs la yang / skabs gang du yum med par bzhed pa yin la/ yum yod par 'dod na yang / skabs thams cad du yum bshad dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ /'dir yum yod pa la sgrub byed gsum las/ dang po dbang gong ma gnyis la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ a mo gha badz+ra'i dkyil chog las/ des na gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /zhes 'jigs byed la yang dbang gnyis pa dang / gsum pa bskur bar bshad pa ltar shin tu yang dgos la/ de la gsang dbang la ni slob ma la nges pa med kyang bla mas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas yum la brten te/ gsang dbang gi rdzas bsgrub dgos la/ dbang gsum pa la ni slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas rig ma lha mor bskyed pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bo bskyed dgos pa la ni khungs thub kyi gzhung du ma yod do/ /de ltar yin pas gtso bo la yum byung ba yin no/

/yum med par 'dod pa dang / sta gon gyi skabs su/ bla mas rang 'od kyi rig ma sprul te snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras slob ma rnams rang gi lus la bcug rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mar gnas pa la/ byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'ang 'gal ba yin no/ /de ltar na bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba dang / gtso bo la yum med par 'dod pa ni ma dag pa chen por shes par gyis shig gnyis pa dgra nag gi gzhung la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi bshad rgyud/ dgra nag gi gzhung dang 'grel pa la brten nas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs ni bsgrubs zin la/ de ltar na 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi mngal nas 'byin par shin tu grub ste/ 'jigs byed la 'khor gyi lha rnams dgra nag la brten nas/ grub chen dpal 'dzin sogs kyi gzhung la brten pa'i rigs pa sbyor du rung la/ lha de rnams kyi bskyed chog la/ de dag gi rigs pa sbyor du mi rung ba'i khyad par dbye bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /mngon rtogs la dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung la brten pa'i rigs pa sbyor nus na 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la rgya gar gyi dkyil chog zur pa ma byung yang dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi dkyil chog dang / a mo gha badz+ra'i dkyil chog la brten pa'i rigs pa sbyor nus te/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis dmar nag gi dkyil chog gnyis mdzad pa la/ gtso bo 'pho ba tsam gyis dbang gi khyad par cung zad mi 'dra ba 'ga' re ma gtogs par spyi khog ji bzhin du 'dra ba dang rigs pa mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du dmar nag gi sgrub thabs gnyis la yang bshad 'dug pa'i rigs pas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la yang dpag nus par shes par gyis shig

gsum pa kyai rdo rje la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ bla med kyi rim pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dgos pa mang du yod kyang / gtso bo ni rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rnams skye ba'i rgyud smin byed du 'gro ba yin la/ de la ni rim pa dang po'i skabs su yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas drangs pa'i bde ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi lta ba gnyis sbyar te rgyun ldan du bsgom dgos pa'i tshul rnams gzhan du rgyas par bshad zin pa ltar yin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rim pa dang po'i skabs su yum bsgom pa med na/ dgos pa de mi 'grub pas bskyed rim gyi gnad ma tshang bar 'gyur na/ 'dod par yang mi nus so/ /tshul de la dogs pa dpyod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs las shin tu gsal bar gsungs te/ kyai rdo rje las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /phyag rgya nyid ces ji ltar brjod/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya gnyis dag gis/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub ji ltar 'grub/ /ces lam 'dis phyag rgya la brten nas dngos grub mi 'grub par bshad pa la/ de ltar bdag med ma gtso bor byas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis phyag rgya'i dngos grub mi 'thob ste/ rig ma bsgom pa med par phyag rgya'i dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang / rang gi phyag rgya ma gzhan gcig bsgoms na/ phyag rgya ma gnyis sbyar nas bde chen mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /des na de 'dra des phyag rgya'i dngos grub ji ltar thob par 'gyur/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur/ /kak+ko la dbus yang dag gnas/ /'gram gnyis dril bu dag tu 'gyur/ /ze'u 'bru bau la can du 'gyur/ /lhag ma bdag nyid chen po nyid/ /dga' chen he ru ka yi gzugs/ /zhes so/ /de 'dra ba de la ni/ bud med lha mo'i gzugs su bsgoms pa spangs nas/

de las gzhan bcom ldan 'das te lha yab kyi gzugs su rnam par bya bar gsungs so/ /des na nu ma spangs pa bau la dang / kak+ko la 'gram gnyis dril bu ste/ 'bras bur 'gyur zhes pa ni/ rten de'i steng nas don de ltar 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/ dmigs pas de dag mi mngon par byas nas rdo rje sogs su bskyed pas so/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bdag med mas mdzad pa la bsgom pa'i tshe mo rtags bsgyur nas pho'i rtags dang ldan par bsgom par gsungs so/ /de yang mu tig phreng bar/ sme ma ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag mo'i mgul nas 'khyud do/ /de las gzhan rnal 'byor ma bdun spros pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang rang gi pad ma las byung ba'i rdo rje dang sbyor bas bcom ldan 'das ma thams cad la yongs su spyod do/ /zhes mchod pa'i lha mo bdun po spros nas g.yung mo la bcug nas/ g.yung mos rang gi pad ma rdo rjer byas te longs spyod par gsungs pa ltar rtags bsgyur ba des phyag rgya ma gzhan la snyoms 'jug byed pa yin no/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lha mo gcig pur bshad pa la yang / sngar gyi dogs pa de nges par skye dgos la/ de gcod pa la yang yum yod pa'i lan gdab dgos kyi/ yum med kyang phyag rgya'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro zhes smra mi rung bas kyai rdo rje la brten nas kyang shin tu 'grub bo gsung ngo / /de lta bu'i sgrub byed rnams kyis ni yum bsgrub mi nus te/ rim pa bzhin sgrub byed dang po ma nges te/ dbang gnyis pa dang gsum pa bskur dgos pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skabs su yang / yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can du bsgom dgos na/ rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i phag mo sngon mo dang / dmar mo dang / ser mo dang / bdag med ma sogs yum rkyang pa'i dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skabs su'ang gtso mo la yab sbyar dgos par 'gyur ro/

/mdor na bla med kyi yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor mi srid par 'gyur te/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor yin na dbang bzhi bskur dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed pas kyang ma khyab ste/ kyai rdor ḍom+bhi ba'i lugs kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ slob ma 'od dpag med du bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du gsang ba 'dus pa'i rjes chags kyi skabs su'ang / rang rin chen 'byung ldan dang / don yod grub pa la sogs par 'gyur bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe ji ltar byed ce na/ rang gi rigs gang yin pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis bskur ba yin pas/ 'dir yang mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis bskur bas chog go /dper na rig pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su yang / slob ma bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par mi bsgom par/ rigs lnga'i rnam par bsgom pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du sta gon gyi skabs su slob ma la nang dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang shes par bya'o/ /sgrub byed gnyis pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ spyir gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la mngal 'byin gyis ma khyab ste/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la ma khyab pa'i phyir dang / khyad par du rdo rje 'jigs byed la de lta bu'i bshad pa rgyud rgya gzhung gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /lha bcu gsum mar 'dod na'ang cog gru shes rab bla ma'i bcu gsum ma dang / gnyis pa'i lha dgu ma bzhin du/ sa bon las bskyed par bya'i mngal 'byin rnam pa thams cad du mi 'thad do/ /'khor gyi lha dgra nag nas bshad pa'i lhar grub pas/

de dag gi cho ga yang dgra nag bzhin rigs so zhe na/ de'ang dgra nag nas bshad pa'i 'khor gyi lhar mi 'grub par gong du bshad zin to/ /sgrub byed gsum pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ 'di la mnga' bdag rgyal ba mai tri pas/ dbang bskur nges bstan du/ 'thob bya'i 'bras bu kha sbyor gyi yan lag dang ldan pa yin pas/ de thob byed kyi rgyu la'ang kha sbyor gyi rnam pa can dgos na/ de 'di la ji ltar rung zhe na/ 'di la kha sbyor gyi don tshang ba yin te/ kha ṭ+wāṃ kas yab mtshon pas thabs shes rab zung du chud pa yin no zhe na/ 'di'ang mdzes pa ma yin te/ thabs shes zung du chud pa tsam pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang yod pas de las khyad par du 'phags par mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ yang 'di la kha sbyor dang ldan pa yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes dang / de yang mi 'thad de/ grub pa'i dus su yin gyi sgrub par byed pa'i dus su ma yin no/ /zhes brgal lan dang bcas nas bshad pa'i phyogs snga yin pas mi 'thad cing / gzhung de dag gi dgongs pa sa skya pa rnams kyang sa bcu par thug gi bar bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor gyis bsgrod nas/ nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe ji ltar byed ce na/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa can gyi pho'i rnam pa can du bsgyur nas/ phyag rgya gzhan dang snyoms par 'jug pas mtshams sbyor bar byed ces ston pa yin gyi/ nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyor ma ran pa'i gong du bskyed rim bsgom pa'i tshe bud med kyi gzugs su bsgom pa spangs nas/ he ru ka'i gzugs su bsgom par ston pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang gi tshe he ru ka'i rnam pa can gyi pho'i gzugs su dngos su bsgyur ba de'i tshe/ he ru ka dngos su bsgyur bas nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ba'i phyir/ bsgyur ba don med do zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/

/de'i tshe bud med kyi gzugs spangs nas/ pho'i gzugs su dngos su bsgyur nus kyi/ skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs kyi he ru ka ni nye rgyu'i mtshams ma sbyar bar dngos su bsgyur mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /mo'i gzugs pho'i gzugs su dngos su bsgyur nus pa yod pa tsam gyis he ru ka yang dngos su bsgyur ba'i nus pa yod dgos na ha cang thal lo/ /rgyas par ni kyai rdo rje las shes par bya'o/ /de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod pa la sgrub byed med pa yin no/ /der ma zad gnod byed kyang yod pa yin te/ khyod 'dod pa ltar gyi yum ro langs ma de 'dra gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te dgra nag gi rgyud las gsungs so snyam na/ der ni yab rang 'dra ba'i yum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yum dbu dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi ma he'i gdong pa can 'dod dgos par 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyud de'i dngos bstan ji lta ba bzhin 'dod na ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug mar 'gyur bas zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mi rigs so/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gshed dmar nas bshad snyam na/ de ltar na sku mdog dmar mor 'gyur bas/ ro langs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ni rang nyid kyis bzos nas sbyar bar zad do/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum rgyud dang rgya gzhung gang nas kyang yod par ma bshad pa yin gyi/ med par bshad pa med ces pa'ang ma brtags pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha'i rnal 'byor ston pa'i rgyud dang rgya gzhung thams cad du liṅga dmar po gyen la langs par bshad pas/ yum med par bstan pa yin te/ yum yod na liṅga yum gyi pad mar nub pas phyi rol tu gyen la langs pa mthong ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir gnod byed kyang yod pa yin no/ /des na yum med pa nyid/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa yin no/

/zhes chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa dag gsung ngo / /zhes pa de dag gis ni khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung rab dngos bshad pa legs par bshad zin nas// ༈ //gnyis pa ni dam pa'i chos byung tshul dang dgag sgrub sogs rje btsun sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rab de nyid dang cha mthun pas na de las 'phros pa'i legs bshad bstan pa la yang gnyis te/ paṇa chen gung ru'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa dang / byams pa chos legs kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang gnyis te/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa dang / de'i lam la dgag sgrub kyi spros pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun e wam̐ pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid dang / de'i thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan te/ yab sras mtshungs med de gnyis kyi dngos kyi slob ma gung ru shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul bshad pa'i legs bshad las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gzhag pa cung zad cig brjod na/ spyir ston pas mdo sngags kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs tshul/ sngags la yang rgyud sde bzhi dang / de'i yang bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis gsungs tshul sogs yod pa las 'dir pha rgyud/ de la yang sde gsum ste/ 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba 'dus pa'i chos skor/ gti mug can gtso bor 'dul ba rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i chos skor/ zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba gshin rje gshed skor las/ 'di phyi ma'o/ /'di la yang dmar nag gnyis las/ gshed dmar ni phyis kha che paṇa chen gyi sku tshe stod smad bar gsum gyi dus/ dpyal chos bzang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chag lo man chad nas 'gyur ba ste/ rgyas par gzhan du shes so/

/nag po'i skor la/ dgra nag gi rgyud rgyas pa khri nyis stong pa la sogs rgyud rgyas pa rnams u rgyan du/ rang byung he ru ka'i gzhal yas khang na yod do zer ba dang / tsan+dan dar byed kyi gling du yod zer yang / shan+ti pas rgyud rgyas pa rnams da lta'i gang zag gi spyod yul ma yin pas mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te/ brtag gnyis rgyud rgyas pa las byung tshul/ gur du bshad pa dang mthun no/ /des na da lta rgya bod du yod pa'i bsdus rgyud ni/ dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa/ gdong drug gi sdom pa gsum pa'i rgyud/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gsum mo/ /dang po la/ grub chen dpal 'dzin dang / shan+ti pa'i 'grel pa dang / the tshom can nag po pa'i 'grel pa'o/ /bar pa la/ de ba a ka ra'i gdong drug gi lha nyer gcig pa'i sgrub thabs yod la/ phyi ma la slob dpon mi bskyod pa gzhon nu zla ba'i 'grel pa yod cing / mdzad byang med pa'i 'grel pa dang / rdo rje grub pa dang / ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta dang / se na shrīs byas so zer ba rnams don gcig ste/ de yang nag po'i rgyud gsum phyogs gcig pas/ dgra nag legs par bshad shes na/ gzhan gnyis sla ba yin no gsungs/ de'i dgra nag ni rtsa ba'i rgyud lta bu/ de'i 'khor lo'i las rgyas par ston pa gdong drug drag las gtso bor ston pa rtog bdun te/ spyir yang gshin rje'i gshed skor 'phrul 'khor ston tshul/ rgyas par bshad pa 'di'i lugs kyi 'khor lo mkhas par shes dgos gsung ngo / /yang 'jigs byed kyi rgyud du btags pa 'khor lo bri ba'i rtog pa zhes pa ni rnying ma ba'i gshin rje'i gdam ngag cig yin no/ /rtog gsum zer ba ni skyo pa'i gdam ngag go /las gshin btul tshul bris pa gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang / de'i brang bkog tshul bris pa gshin rje brang dmar gyi rtog pa dang / ngan sngags las mkhan te'u le'i rtog pa rnams bde ba jos byas par 'dod/

'o na bod du nag po'i chos skor nam byung snyam na/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i slob ma spu hrang lo chung legs pa'i shes rab kyi slob ma zhang shes rab bla mas rgya gar du de wa a ka ra tsaṇ+ḍa dang / a mo gha chung ba la zhus nas/ nag po'i rgyud chos skor dang bcas pa rgyud gsum gdam ngag gi sgo nas bshad thabs/ grub chen la li ta'i zhe dgu ma'i sgrub dkyil 'phrul 'khor dang bcas pa khyer nas byon pa'i bshad srol/ mnyam bzhag tu rim gnyis bsgom/ rjes spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo bzhin mdzad/ slob ma 'jug rim dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang tsam bskur sgrub thabs bslabs/ de nas slob dpon gyi dbang bskur nas rgyud bslabs/ de nas bsnyen bsgrub byas te rgyud 'chad/ mchog bsgrub pa la gtso bor mdzad nas thun mong zhar la 'byung ba ma gtogs ngan mthu sogs mi mdzad/ rgyas pa'i 'phrul 'khor la 'od zer dang 'ja' tshon byung ste/ 'bring mtshams thams cad dang / gtsang stod thams cad khong gi chos lugs byed skad/ phyis zhang pa sangs rgyas 'byung la/ 'phags pa rin po che dang / dus 'khor ba me rin/ 'dzim pa rin she sogs kyis zhang lugs zhus nas/ sa skya pa rnams la'ang yod do/ /yang bla ma skyos zhang shes rab bla ma la rgyud gsum zhus/ de dus zhang gi bla ma a mo gha chung ba bod du byon pa dbus su spyan drangs nas 'jigs byed bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs nas/ zhi ba las bdun/ drag po las gnyis/ drag las phyogs gcig pa sogs gnang ngo / /rtog gsum dang zhi ba las bdun sogs mthun par 'dug pas/ skyo pa'i gdam ngag go gsungs so/ /des na 'phrul 'khor la rtog gsum dang zhi ba las bdun sogs kyi lung rtog bdun dang / dgra nag sogs kyi lugs/ dus 'khor sogs kyi lugs te rigs gsum shes dgos gsung ngo / /yang skyo la gnyan gyis zhus nas/ dbus kyi gnyan 'od srung / gnyan rin chen brtan sogs te 'od srung la 'phags pa rin po ches skyo lugs zhus so/

/rje sa chen gyi bla ma mal la/ nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i nag po'i rgyud gsum ste/ gdong drug gi bka' ni da lta chad 'dug go /yang mar pa dang dus mnyam pa/ gnyos lo tsā bas rgya gar du ba liṃ ta a tsar+ya la rgyud de bshad pa khag chod gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs/ grags khag chod nag po'i rgyud gsum/ chos skyong khag chod trag shad thal mo rdab chog rnams zhus nas/ gdong drug min pa da lta'ang yod skad/ gzhan yang gnyos la dgra nag gi rigs bzhi yum bzhis bskor ba yod kyang / bcu gsum ma dang / dkyil 'khor mngal 'byin dang / gtso bo la yum mi 'dod/ gnyos lugs ni/ gnyos pa la dang / sa skya pa/ na bza' ba/ shākya seng ge dang / lho pa byang dpal sogs la byung / yang mgo bo'i slob ma rwa los rgya gar du sa man ta shrī la phag mo mngon 'byung / mgon po mngon 'byung / he ru ka mngon 'byung ste/ lo i pa'i bka' dang / mngon 'byung rnam gsum/ bdag po'i rgyud gsum zhus/ bal po hoṃ thung la bsad bka' las kyi gdam ngag zhus te/ rwa lo 'di stod kyi snye nam pa yin skad/ khong gi bka' 'grel gcig mun nag mda' 'phen/ bka' 'grel phyogs mthong 'ben la gtad ces pa bcud kyi thigs pa/ bsad las kha rgyud ma/ ha la'i shog gril gsum/ dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa sogs dpe cha re bdun tsam yod kyang / bka' 'grel dang bcud thigs kyi dpe ngos zin dka' zhing / shog gril la yang / rgya ston gyi bzod pa rin chen ma/ khrag long ma/ lag len khrigs chags ma sogs tshul du ma bris pas man ngag bcol ba red/ rwa'i bcu gsum ma sogs yod kyang / drag las can min pa mkhas rgyud du ma red cing / bcu gsum ma'i sgrub dkyil dpal 'dzin ltar byed zer yang / dpal 'dzin dang mi mthun la/ drag las can ma gtogs mkhas rgyud ma yin no/ /de ltar na rgya bal la zhus pa'i lugs lnga'o/ /de'i rjes sa paṇa gyi slob ma zur po brag nag pa/

gdong ston shes rab dpal la 'phags pas rwa lugs zhus so/ /gdong ston 'di rwa lugs pa yin kyang / dus 'khor gyi gza' lnga'i sbyor ba sogs bsres 'dug go gsungs/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyang rwa lugs la mkhas par grags kyang / rgyud bshad pa la sa lugs kyi lam 'bras bsres pa zhang lugs zhe dgu ma'i zhi khro'i sgrub thabs so sor byas pa skyo lugs kyi rtog gsum la zhi bas 'jigs pa brgyad las skyobs/ rgyas pa yon tan drug dang sbyor/ /dbang gis mos pa rnam bzhi 'grub/ /ces pa la brten nas g.yag lug rma bya rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la 'phrul 'khor bri ba sogs byas kyang / rgyud du drag las la gshin rje'i lus la 'phrul 'khor bri bar bshad kyi/ gzhan ma bshad pas/ phan tshun bsres 'dug go gsung ngo / /yang 'gar dam pas rwa lo la zhus pa'i bcu gsum ma yod cing phyis gnyos lha nang pa la gnyos lugs zhus skad/ yang rong pa sher seng nas brgyud de/ bu ston pas ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dkyil chog dang / rtog gsum gyi rtog pa dang po'i ṭīk+ka la 'phrul 'khor lugs gsum thams cad mi 'grig bzhin du thams cad gcig byas pa ste yig cha gnyis mdzad do/ /de yang dkyil chog kyang bcu bdun ma'i ltar la dpal 'dzin gyi lugs 'ga' re bsres pa dag go /de'i steng nas sgrub thabs bris kyang / bdag bskyed la gshin rje mo brgyad byed na/ mdun bskyed la gshin rje pho dang / sgrub thabs dngos gzhi la gshin rje mo brgyad bsgom dgos tshul ma shes 'dug go /yang 'bri khung lo tsā bas dus 'khor jo lugs cung zad bsres te/ gshed skor gyi yig cha mang po byas/ de yang bal po ma na ka shrī la zhus skad/ yang dbus stod dpal 'dzin gyis gshed skor gyi gdam ngag mang po byas pa dang / yang khams pa bla ma la yon tan 'bum pa dang / dam lung pa gnyis byung ba snga ma mkhas shing / rwa lugs kyi gdam ngag yod pa de yin pa 'dug ste/

'di rnams thams cad rwa lugs so/ /gzhan yang phyis su 'jigs byed kyi bsgrub dkyil byed mkhan shin tu mang po byung yang / mi mkhas pa shas che'o/ /de ltar rtog bdun la brten nas/ rgya gar bas bkral tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis pa'i dang po la/ rtog pa dang por phyag mtshan bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo mtshams su ro langs brgyad 'god pa'i dbus su/ gtso bo bkod pas ro langs brgyad bskor te/ phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du song zhing ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa dang / rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig la yang phyag mtshan 'god par bshad do/ /ro langs brgyad bskor 'di rtog bdun pa thams cad 'dod kyang / slob dpon a bos bdag mdun gnyis kar lha dgur bsgom par bshad la/ gzhan rnams kyi rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar bdag bskyed dpa' gcig mdun bskyed la lha dgu byed do/ /slob dpon a pos byas pa la/ la li ta'i gzhung chung zer yang min no gsung ngo / /yang grub chen la li tas rtog bdun du dkyil 'khor la phyag mtshan so gsum 'god par bshad pa'i phyogs bzhir gri gug sogs kyi sogs khongs su zhabs g.yas pa'i 'og gi gdan rnams phyung ste 'god/ ro langs rnams ro langs kyi sgrub pa byed dus dgos/ slob ma dbang bskur la dor la zhabs g.yon gyi 'og gi gdan rnams phyung ste bkod/ de rnams lhar bskyed sa bon ya ma ra dza sogs so gnyis lha snam gyi lha'i sa bon/ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥle dgu'i ya man ta ka phyag la gnon/ sngags gsum pa'i hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā sgo mtshams kyi oṃ gyis 'gre/ de ltar na gtso bo'i sku cha shas zhe dgu sku'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du song ba yin no/ /lha'i phyag mtshan ni kha cig rang gis dang po rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes pas g.yas pa rnams rdo rje/ g.yon gri gug sogs phyag mtshan rang rang 'dzin zer yang /

phyag mtshan gyi dang po bri ste/ rdo rje gri gug rdo rje mgo bo zhes sogs so/ /des na g.yas phyag mtshan rang rang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa lags te/ dag par thod pa bshad do/ /'di ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gdam ngag khyad par can te/ skyo zhang las brgyud do/ /yang a mo ghas bdag bskyed kyi thun mong min pa'i srung 'khor la gshin rje pho brgyad 'khor la bkod/ dngos gzhi la gshin rje mo brgyad bskyed/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor nang du gshin rje mo brgyad bkod/ phyi'i pad ra'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du gshin rje pho brgyad bsgom/ bri dus der ma bshad pas rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon la 'god do/ /de ltar na lha bcu gnyis ma'i dkyil 'khor byas te/ las sbyor gyi skabs su gshin rje nyi ma bzhi pa'i las sbyor du gshin rje pho mo gnas pa la brten no/ /'dis kyang brgyud pa 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor du song ngo / /lugs 'di skyo pa dang / gnyos kho na las byung ngo / /de rnams khungs thub bo/ /yang gnyis pas gong du bshad pa ltar lha dgu ma byas so/ /yang rwa lo phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor la ro langs brgyad/ mgo dang rkang lag gsum gsum pa bri/ dbang bskur dus ro langs rnams rdza thod kyis bkab/ steng du sgo ba sogs kyi phyag mtshan bri/ dbang bskur tshar dus rdza thod bsal/ yang gtso bo 'jigs byed la/ dgra nag gi 'khor gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs sbyar ba'i bcu gsum ma byas shing / 'di dang gnyos pa'i lha dgu ma gnyis ka la brgyud pa'i phyag mtshan rnams ma chad par bri'o/ /phyag mtshan gzhan yang zhes sogs sgrub thabs bdun byas kyang / zhal gcig pa la slob dpon 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs gcig 'dug pas/ phyag bzhi drug pa ni bha ro'i gzhung chung ba de zer ba tsam las rgya bal gyi gzhung med do/ /phyis kyi kha cig zhe dgu ma zer nas rgyud du bshad pa'i phyag mtshan so gsum lhar bskyed nas ro langs brgyad bkod pa yin skad/

de mi 'thad de/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar byed na phyag mtshan lhar bskyed pa med la/ la li ta ltar na/ ro langs mi bkod pa rang bzo kho na yin no/ /dpa' gcig la srung 'khor gzhal yas khang gi nang du gtso bo bskyed pa dang / srung 'khor du dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su gtso bo bskyed pa dang / pad nyi'i steng du gtso bo bskyed pa sogs yod/ de la slob dpon shrī bha dra dang / sa skya gong mas dpa' gcig la brten pa dus gcig bskyed pa mdzad/ rwa lo so so la sku gsung thugs kyi zhing skyong sogs byed kyang rgyud gzhung du med/ de yang rtog bdun 'chad tshul zhang pa rgyas kyang / sa lugs/ rwa lugs la rgyas pa rang mi 'dug go /de yang sa skya pa chen po'i ṭīka chung ltar 'chad na/ shrī bha dra dang / mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa dang mthun zhing legs pa yin no/ /de yang rtog gnyis kyi 'grel pa ni/ gang zag rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi dbang bskur/ sgrub thabs bsgom/ sngags bzlas thun mong du'o/ /de nas gang zag rab bsam gtan gyi rtog pa ltar las grub/ 'bring bsam gtan ni med par sbyin sreg mnon/ tha ma 'khor lo yang mnon pas rtog pa gnyis su nges so/ /mi bskyod pa'i 'grel par yang don de'o/ /rwa lugs la de lta bu'i 'grel pa med par bsad las kho na la dril te/ dang po thams cad kyang mdun du tshom bu'i sgrub mchod tshar nas/ shar du 'phrul 'khor gyis bsad/ lhor sbyin sreg nub tu thams cad kyi tshogs 'khor/ byang du gtor ma ste bsad las sde bzhir byed do/ /skyo pas zhi sogs las gang bsgrub kyang las bdun te/ nyi ma dang po tshogs gsog gnyis par gtor ma gtong / gsum bzhir 'khor lo bri/ lnga pa nas 'phrul 'khor sgrub thabs su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su sbyin sreg byed par bzhed/ 'di ni 'dod rgyal gyi bsgrub par bshad pa dang cha 'dra'o/ /zhes pa de dag gis ni gung ru shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul gyi rnam gzhag gtso bor bstan pa'i legs bshad bshad zin nas/

gnyis pa de'i lam la dgag sgrub kyi spros pa bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ yang mkhas pa'i dbang po gung ru shes rab bzang po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dgag bsgrub kyi zur 'debs zhes bya ba'i gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir 'jigs byed kyi rgyud ngos 'dzin pa la snga rabs pa dag mtshan brjod du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa la 'phros nas 'jigs byed kyi rgyud dang / mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /zhes pa la 'phros nas gdong drug gi rgyud dang / kha cig ha la ha la gdong brgya pa/ /zhes pa la 'phros nas/ pra khog lang gi rgyud gsungs pa yin zhing / 'jigs byed la'ang rtsa rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/ de'i bshad rgyud rtog gsum dang / gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang / las mkhan te'u le pa'i rtog pa sogs du ma bzhed kyang / rje btsun sa skya pa rnams ni/ dgra nag gi rgyud las 'phros te/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'dir drag las zur du bsad las tsam zhig gtso bor ston par bzhed cing / de'i don yang dgra nag tu/ rgyal mtshan can gyi 'khyams mthong nas/ /de nas 'o ma btung bar bya/ /zhes pa la brten nas/ rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa thon par 'dod pa yin gyi/ rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa rgya mi che la/ khyad par 'jigs byed la ni/ mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rtag tu mar me cher bza' zhing / /gsum 'bum dag tu bzla bar bya/ /zhes pa la nges don gyi bshad pa byas pas/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi rdzogs rim tsam zhig ston par 'dod pa yin gyis/ bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa rgya mi che bar/ bsad las gtso bor ston pa yin te/ 'di'i rgyud du/ 'dir bsad pa'i las gtso bor gyur pa yin phyir zhes gsungs pa dang / rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa mi bskyod pas mdzad par/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la rlung me'i dkyil 'khor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan du/

gtor dang sreg par byed pa'i phyir/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /drag po'i las la shin tu bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rgyud de rnams las gang gtso bor byed ce na/ rtog bdun kho na gtso bor byed do/ /gzhan rnams ni bod kyis sbyar ba'i rdzus mar grags shing / rtog gsum ni/ 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag zab mo ston yang / skyo pa'i bla ma gcig gis mdzad pa yin gyi/ rwa pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa mi 'dod do/ /de yang mdor bsdu na/ 'jigs byed la lha dpa' bo gcig pa dang / dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gnyis su nges/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la yang dkyil 'khor rnam dag gsum/ bod kyi man ngag gis bzos pa gnyis/ rtog btags kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dang brgyad du yod/ de la rnam dag gsum ni/ ro langs brgyad bskor/ zhe dgu ma/ bcu bdun ma dang gsum mo/ /man ngag gi gnyis ni/ rwa pa'i bcu gsum ma dang / gnyos pa'i dgu ma dang gnyis so/ /rtog btags kyi gsum ni/ zhe gcig ma/ nyang stod kyi a mo gha badz+ra gyis byas kyang / mai tri dzo kas mdzad par grags pa'i mi tra brgya rtsa'i nang gi 'jigs byed lha lnga ma dang gnyis/ yang phyis kyi kha cig rwa lugs kyi bcu ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ lung rigs kyi bsgrub byed kyang rwa pa dang mi mthun/ lung rigs kyis bsgrubs pa'i lha'i mngon dkyil yang / rwa ba dang gtan mi mthun pa'i bcu gsum ma byas pa dang gsum mo/ /de yang phyogs snga smra ba po khyod kyis dgag bsgrub de rnams la tshig mang po bris 'dug kyang / mdor bsdu na/ bcu gsum ma 'di/ rwa lo tsā bas rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus nas/ bod du srol phye ba tsam yin gsung ba tsam ma gtogs/ rgyud rgya gzhung nas dngos su gsungs pa dang / gzhan gyi srol 'byed mkhan ma byung bar mthun snang du grub kyang / rwa lo tsā bas srol phye ba'i bcu gsum ma 'di 'thad pa'i sgrub byed drag shos 'dir 'dug ste/

de yang rtog bdun gyi skabs su/ bya rog gi sgros 'phrul 'khor ling tshe bcu drug pa bris la/ zhes sogs kyis 'phrul 'khor mdor bstan/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor bris bsgrub kyi skabs su/ yi ge yak+ṣa ma me dang / ya tsa ni ra dza pa do t+yu ṇa yo ni ra/ bkod par bshad cing / dgra nag las/ yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces pa nas/ ṇa yo ni ra mtshams bzhi ru/ /thod pa bzhi ru sgrags pa 'o/ /zhes yi ge bcu bdun lha bcu gsum dang / thod pa bzhi ru bskyed par gsungs pa'i tshig des/ 'phrul 'khor gyi ya k+ṣe sogs dgra nag gis lhar bskyed par bstan pas/ dgra nag gi 'khor bum thod bzhi dang bcas pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma grub ste/ 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs yin pas/ gtso bo 'jigs byed kyis byed dgos shing / 'phrul 'khor gyi yi ge rnams dgra nag lhar bskyed pa sgos su bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs par 'dug go /'o na gshed dmar bcu gsum 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gcig dang / gdong drug gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gcig rnams dgos par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su/ yi ge k+ṣe sogs bkod par bshad la/ yi ge de rnams kyang gshed dmar dang / gdong drug gi skabs su/ yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces sogs kyis gshed dmar dang / gdong drug gi lhar bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i 'khor bcu bzhi pas bskor ba'i 'jigs byed bco lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig kyang 'thad par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su a li bcu drug 'god par bshad la/ de nyid bdag med ma'i skabs su/ a li dang po bdag med ma/ /zhes sogs lha mo bco lngar bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir ro/

/gzhan yang rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor skabs su/ yi ge nga nya gnyis ma gtogs pa'i gsal byed gnyis bkod cing / dus 'khor gyi skabs su/ ka li rnams lhar bskyed par bstan pas/ lha de rnams kyi gtso bo 'jigs byed kyis byas pa'i dkyil 'khor yang khas len dgos pa sogs nyes pa mtha' yas/ de la phyogs snga ma smra ba na re/ skyon de rnams mi 'jug ste/ gshed dmar dang / gdong drug dang / kyai rdor dang / dus 'khor gyi skabs su/ lhar bskyed par bstan pa'am/ yi ge ya k+ṣe sogs dang / a li ka li rnams rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor skabs kyi yi ge sogs dang / a li ka li rnams dang ming mthun pa tsam yin gyi/ rtog gsum gyi yi ge rnams phar khyer nas/ gshed dmar/ gdong drug bdag med ma dang / dus 'khor sogs su lhar bskyed pa min par/ gshed dmar sogs rgyud so so'i skabs kyi yi ge ya k+ṣe sogs dang / a li ka li rnams rgyud so so'i lha de dang der bskyed pa'i phyir sgrub byed 'brel med do/ /zhes na bden mod/ nged kyang de ltar du 'dod pa'i phyir dang / khyod kyi sgrub byed de rnams kyis kyang / dgra nag gi 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gtan mi 'grub ste/ dgra nag gi skabs su lhar bskyed par bstan pa'i yi ge ya k+ṣe sogs dang / 'jigs byed rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs kyi ya k+ṣe sogs ming mthun pa tsam yin gyi/ 'phrul 'khor gyi yi ge de rnams phar khyer nas/ dgra nag gi lhar bskyed pa min par/ dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs kyi yi ge ya k+ṣe sogs dgra nag gi lhar bskyed pa bstan pa'i phyir na 'brel gtan nas med do/ /kye gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod mdzod dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum pa'i sgrub byed drag shos de'i mtshang da gzod rtogs par mi 'dug gam/ gzhan yang dpal chen rdo rje grub pa dang /

so na shrī gnyis kas/ yi ge bcu bdun po de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgom la/ gshin rje gshed lha bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ mchod nas dgug gzhug bcing gsum byed par gsungs pa'i don/ dgra nag gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i lha bcu gsum ma dang / bum thod bzhi la 'bru gnon pa ni nor ba chen po yin te/ bum thod lha'i grangs su brtsi na/ gshed dmar lha lnga pa de lha dgu par 'gyur ba dang / bde mchog sogs bum thod yod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la rig pa de ltar mtshungs pa sogs nyes pa mtha' yas shing / lung don yang / las sbyor gyi skabs su bshad pa'i gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad la 'jigs byed gtso bor byas pa'i 'jigs byed bcu bdun ma grub chen a mo ghas bkral ba ltar yin pa'i don ma go bar zad do/ /gzhan yang rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor skabs la brten nas/ rwa lugs kyi 'jigs byed bcu gsum mar bsgrub pa ni/ gsung rab la rgyus chung ba'i gdul bya rnams mgo skor ba'i gtam yin te/ skyo ba sogs kyi rtog gsum tshad mar byed kyang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gtan mi 'dod/ rwa los bcu gsum ma 'dod kyang / rtog gsum tshad mar mi byed pa'i phyir te/ rtog bdun gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi ling tshe bcu drug pa bris la zhes pa'i don du/ rtog gsum la nang du ling tshe bzhi/ de'i phyi rol tu ling tshe bcu gnyis dang bcu drug byed pa ltar mi 'dod kyi/ rtog bdun kho na la brten nas nang du ling tshe brgyad/ de'i phyi rol tu yang ling tshe brgyad dang bcu drug tu 'bru mnan nas/ lnga po gang rung legs bsgom nas/ /bdun po gang rung bri bya ste/ /zhes dang / me gsum gyis bsreg pa sogs bshad la/ de'i don yang / rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs lnga po gang rung bsgom/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum re re ba dang /

gnyis re gnyis re dang / gsum char bris pa'i 'phrul 'khor bdun po gang rung gcig bris te/ 'phrul 'khor gyi me dang / sngags kyi me dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi me dang gsum zhes sogs rtog gsum dang mi mthun pa'i zab khyad mang po mdzad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang khyod kyi 'dod pa'i bcu gsum ma 'di/ mkhas pa su'i lugs su yang ma song ste/ rwa lo dpon slob las gzhan pa'i mkhas pa sus kyang 'di 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dod pa ma byung zhing / rwa lo'i lugs su yang ma song bar de dang mi mthun pa du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ 'dir gtso bo'i zhal 'gyed mi mthun/ phyag mtshan 'dzin tshul mi mthun/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bri tshul mi mthun/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri tshul mi mthun/ 'phrul 'khor bri tshul mi mthun/ bzlas pa byed tshul mi mthun/ gtso bo la yum yod tshul mi mthun pa sogs 'di lta ste rim pa bzhin du ston pa ni/ rwa los gtso bo'i zhal g.yas g.yon rnams rwa la 'khod pa'i tshul gyi brtsegs zhal dang / de'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis rwa'i g.yas g.yon du brtsegs zhal du bzhed kyang / khyod kyis 'khor zhal byas shing / go rim la yang g.yas zhal sngon po'i rjes su dmar po ser po gnyis 'ong ba 'khor brtsigs su 'dod pa thams cad mthun yang / khyod kyis dmar ser gnyis kyi bar du sngon po 'ong bar byas pas nor/ phyag rnams kyang mdun rgyab tu bsgrigs nas yod par rwa lo sogs mkhas pa rnams mthun kyang / khyed kyis stod smad bzhi bsgrigs bzhi rim du byas pas nor/ phyag mtshan rwa pas glang lpags tha ma gnyis kyis 'dzin pa dang / g.yon gyi bcu bzhi pa nyid sdigs mdzub mdzad par 'dod kyang / khyed kyis glang lpags dang po gnyis kyis 'dzin pa dang / g.yon gyi bcu bzhi pas sdigs mdzub byas pas lag mgo gcig 'dzin par byas pas nor/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la yang / rwa los dbus kyi le dgu la lha 'god pa'i tshe/

rgyud le dgu la/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ dbus su ro ril po sogs phyag mtshan rnams bkod par bshad pas/ ling tshe nang gi lha so so'i gdan khri la bris pa ltar bshad kyang / khyod kyis de rnams bcad nas ma bris pas nor/ rwa los rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshe ro langs kyi lha mtshan rnams rdza'i thod pas bkab nas/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshe/ de bsal ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag yod kyang / khyed kyis de ltar ma byas pas nor/ rwa los rtog gsum tshang mar mi byed pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi rnam gzhag gong du smos pa ltar bzhed kyang / khyed kyis rtog gsum ltar byas pas nor/ rwa los bzlas pa byed pa'i tshe/ gtso bo la yum med par mdun du rang 'dra'i 'jigs byed bsgom nas/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi zhal du sngags phreng bsnol mar 'khor ba'i bar du dgra bgegs btsir ba'i dmigs pa sogs bzhed kyang / khyed kyis yum yod pa'i bzlas tshul byas pas nor/ rwa los slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su bsam gtan gyi yum tsam zhig 'dod kyang / bzlas pa dang / dkyil 'khor bris pa dang / sku bzhengs pa sogs skabs gzhan du yum mi bzhed pa yin la/ khyed kyis de las bzlog ste rnam pa kun tu yum khas blangs pas nor/ gzhan yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' yas kyang / yi ge mang pas 'dir ma bris so/ /'o na nged kyi 'dod pa'i bcu gsum ma 'gog gam/ rwa lugs kyi bcu gsum ma yang 'gog ce na/ khyed kyi bcu gsum ma 'di su'i lugs dang mi mthun zhing sgrub byed rnams ltar snang kho nar 'dug pas mi 'thad ces smras pa yin gyi/ rwa lugs ni btang snyoms su bzhag par bya'o/ /'di'i skabs su yang phyogs snga mas 'jigs byed la yum yod pa'i sgrub byed gsum po'i don mdor bsdus pa ni 'dir 'dug ste/ dgra nag gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gcig 'thad pas/

de'i lha rnams mngal 'byin byed dgos pa dang / dbang gong ma gsum bskur ba'i tshe/ gsang dbang la slob dpon dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum du bskyed dgos pa dang / bdag med ma yum rkyang la pho'i gzugs su bsgyur nas shes rab ye shes dang snyoms par 'jug dgos pa dogs spong dang bcas te gsungs pa'i rigs pas 'jigs byed sogs pho rkyang la yang dogs pa de ltar byung bas/ rgyu mtshan de gsum gyi phyir na 'jigs byed la yum yod par grub cing / yum yod par dngos su bshad pa med kyang / yum med pa'i bshad pa yang mi 'dug pas/ yum yod par grub pa yin no gsungs par 'dug go /'di la sgrub byed dang pos 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma yod pa'i rigs pas/ 'jigs byed la yum yod par mi 'grub ste/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma rang yang mi 'thad pas/ khyad gzhi med na khyad chos med pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dbang gong ma gsum la brten nas 'jigs byed la yum yod par 'dod pa ni/ khyed rang gi sgos dpon a bh+ya dang dngos su 'gal te/ des mdzad pa'i rdo rje phreng bar phag mo dmar mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / ser mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / sngon mo'i dkyil 'khor dang / ku ru kul+le'i dkyil 'khor te yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor du ma dang / sangs rgyas thod pa yab rkyang gi dkyil 'khor bshad pa rnams kyis lha yab med pa la yab dang / yum med pa la yum dngos su sbyor dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ dkyil 'khor de rnams la dbang gong ma gsum bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams la yum sbyar dgos par 'dod na/ yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor mi srid par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das ni shes rab ma dang bral ba'o/ /zhes a bh+yas dngos su bshad pa dang 'gal ba yin no/

/gzhan yang bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo de yang yab kyai rdor gcig dang sbyar dgos par 'gyur te/ de la dbang bzhi rdzogs yod pa'i phyir/ de 'dod na bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor de kyai rdor lha bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du khas len dgos pa sogs nyes pa mtha' yas shing / rdo rje phreng bar bshad pa'i lha yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor rnams dang / gzhan nas bshad pa'i yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur tshul gyi lag len tsam yang ma bslabs shing ma shes pas lan no/ /yang kha cig yum ro langs ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar 'jigs byed la sbyor ba gang nas bshad byas pas/ kyai rdor gyi khro bo gshin rje gshed la yum ro langs ma yod la/ de zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma yin te/ yab de zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na dgra nag la zhal gsum phyag drug pa dang / gshed dmar yab zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la/ yum de gnyis kyang zhal gsum ma dang / zhal gcig mar byung ba'i rig pas shes zhes bris snang ngo / /des ni 'jigs byed la zhal dgu phyag so bzhi pa'i yum gcig khas ma blangs sam soms la/ kyai rdor gyi khro bo gshin rje gshed yum ro langs ma de 'jigs byed la sbyor rgyu'i yum yin par da rung sgrubs shig yang bdag med ma'i skabs su/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyi rigs pas kyang 'jigs byed la yum mi 'grub ste/ lung de rnams kyi don nye rgyus mtshams sbyor dus/ bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom mkhan gyi bud med des/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i thabs gcig rnyed na de dang snyoms par 'jug cing / de ma rnyed na rang pho'i gzugs su bsgyur te mtshan ldan gyi rig ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i don yin gyi slob lam nas lha mo'i gzugs bsgoms pa spangs te/

pho'i gzugs su bsgyur te bsgom par 'dod pa la/ mnga' bdag mai tri ba'i dbang bskur nges bstan gyi 'grel par dngos su dgag pa mdzad pa'i phyir dang / da lta nas de 'dra'i gzugs su bsgyur tshul byas nas bsgom dka' ba'i phyir te/ skyes pho mo gang yin yang yum bdag med ma'i bskyed rim bsgom pa'i tshe/ rang nyid mor bsgyur ba'i bdag med ma'i gzugs ma yin par phor bsgyur ba'i he ru ka yin pa de yum gzhan zhig dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i sku yin no snyam du bsgom par bya na/ yab kyi bskyed rim bsgom tshul dang khyad par ci yod bstan dgos shing de 'dra'i bsgom tshul yang ma brtags pa chen po yin no/ /gal te rang nyid bdag med ma yin par bsgom yang / yab gzhan zhig dang mnyam par sbyor bar bsgom pa yin no snyam na/ 'o na/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa bo lar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyi lung don gyi 'bru non par phyin ci log tu 'gyur te/ bud med kyi gzugs ni ma spangs la/ nu ma spangs pa de bo lar 'gyur ba yang min par rang mor gyur pa de/ pho gzhan gcig dang mnyam par sbyor bar khas blangs shing / de ltar phyin ci log tu 'bru mnan pa'i phyir/ yang de ltar na pho'i gzugs su bsgyur ba'i nus pa ni yod mi zer las che bas dgongs mdzod cig yang 'jigs byed la yum med na/ bskyed rim kyi skabs su bde ba skyed byed med pas/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su/ bde chen gyi ye shes mi skye bar 'gyur gsungs pa yang mi 'thad de/ yum med kyang liṅga dmar po gyen la bsgreng bar bshad pas/ de nyid bde ba rgyas pa'i rtags su bshad pa'i phyir dang / de ltar min na lha yab rkyang dang / yum rkyang gi bskyed rdzogs bsgom du mi rung ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis 'jigs byed la yum med par bshad pa med gsungs kyang /

yum med do zhes pa'i tshig ma byung du chug kyang / don thob 'jigs byed la yum med pa'i bshad pa shin tu nas kyang yod de/ rgyud rtog bdun gyi ras bris kyi rtog pa'i skabs su/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku liṅga dmar po gyen la bsgreng ba dang bcas te bri bar bshad la/ de'i tshe yum dang sbyor na yab kyi liṅga mthong bar bri sa med pa'i phyir dang / ling ga dmar po gyen du bsgreng bar dgos par bshad pa'i khungs thub kyi lung mang ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te yum yod par 'dod kyang / thang sku la yum dang sbyar nas bri ba min pas skyon med do zhe na/ 'o na khyed kyis 'jigs byed kyi bri bsgom bzhengs gsum thams cad la yum dang sbyar ba dang 'gal lo/ /'di dag gi skabs su 'di lta bu'i dgag sgrub kyi don la spyod pa'i blo nus med kyang / gzhan gyi kha rgyug gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ blo gzu bor mi gnas pa'i skye bo dag na re/ 'jigs byed kyi yum 'gog pa pos 'jigs byed la yum med de/ 'jigs byed kyi liṅga dmar po gyen du bsgreng ba'i phyir ro zhes zer tshod du 'dug pas/ 'o na rang re'i pha rgan rnams la yang yum chung ma med par 'gyur te/ liṅga dmar po gyen du bsgreng ba'i phyir ro/ /des na liṅga gyen la bsgreng ba nyid kyi phyir na yum yod par grub pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i skyon song ba yin zer ba'i cho nges du ma sgrogs par grag go /de skad smra ba dag gi ni dran 'dzin brtan pa'i sgo nas gong gi dgag bsgrub rnams la legs par dpyod la rang re'i pha rgan rnams liṅga gyen du bsgreng ba dang bcas te/ thang sku la bri bar gang nas bshad bstan dgos so/ /de ltar rtags su mi 'god na/ khyed rang tsho'i thal 'gyur de phar bzlog ste/ 'phangs pas 'khor gsum dngos 'gal yin te/ nged la khas blang gang yang ston rgyu med pa'i 'brel med kyi thal 'gyur du 'dug pa'i phyir/

liṅga gyen du 'greng ba nyid kyi phyir na yum yod par grub ces smras pas/ smra ba po rang chung ma yod par khas blangs pa min nam/ legs par soms shig yang 'jigs byed la yum yod par 'dod pa ni/ 'jigs byed kyi zhal ma he'i gdong pa'i tshul gyis ring por yod cing / zhal shar nas blta bar bshad pa'i rgya gzhung gi don yang bkag pa yin te/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i lcags mkhar bcu bdun po de/ 'jigs byed kyi zhabs bcu drug liṅga dang bcu bdun pos bshig pa'i dgos pa sogs yod pas/ sku'i mdun phyogs lhor bstan yang zhal shar du gzigs par bshad pa la/ khyed kyi yum dang zhal sbyar nas yab kyi zhal yang mdun du lhor phyogs pa dang / gdong pa yang thung du btang bas/ g.yag mgo ltar bzos pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rwa lugs las slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su 'jigs byed la yum gcig yod par 'dod pa min nam snyam na/ de ltar bshad kyang slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su 'jigs byed la rang 'od kyi yum zhig bsgom pa tsam gyis/ 'jigs byed kyi thang sku tshun chod yum bri ba la sogs pa rnam pa kun tu yum khas len dgos na/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa khyed rang sku gzugs kyi thang ga bri ba la/ yum bri dgos pa sogs rnam pa kun tu khyod rang la yum yod dgos par 'gyur te/ khyed rang gis 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs su/ khyed rang yum dang mnyam par sbyor bar bsgom pa'i phyir/ 'di'i rtags dang khyab pa gnyis char khyed rang gi zhal gyis bzhes so/ /zhes zhus na ci gsung / yang kha cig na re/ 'jigs byed kyi las tshogs kyi skabs su/ grong khyer gyi bu mo bkug nas de dang rol bar bshad la/ bla med pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas lha yab yum gyi 'du shes kyis rol dgos la/ lha yang 'dir 'jigs byed las 'os med pas/ 'jigs byed la yum grub zhes bris snang ngo /

/'o na sangs rgyas thod pa yab rkyang dang / ku ru kul+le lta bu yum rkyang bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi las tshogs kyi skabs su/ grong khyer gyi bu mo dbang du bsdus nas rol ba sogs bshad pas/ lha yab rkyang dang yum rkyang de rnams la yang yab med la yab dang / yum med la yum sbyor dgos par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi phyag rgya bkug ste rol bar byed pa'i tshe lha'i 'du shes kyis rol dgos par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang khyed kyis 'di skad du/ g.yon pa'i phyag bcu bzhi pas sdigs mdzub byas pa'i lag mgo gcig 'dzin dgos kyi/ bcu bzhi pa nyid kyis sdigs mdzub byed pa mi 'thad de/ sdigs mdzub sogs phyag mtshan rnams dkyil 'khor la 'god par bshad pas/ de ltar bkod pa'i rjes su/ g.yon pa'i bcu bzhi pa'i phyag mgo chad pa'i skyon yod ces gsungs pa yang phyogs gcig kho na la bsam pa'i rigs pa ltar snang yin te/ gri gug nas glang lpags kyi bar/ phyag mtshan so gsum po thams cad dkyil 'khor la 'god par bshad pas/ de ltar bkod pa'i rjes su/ phyag so bzhi la phyag mtshan bzung rgyu med par lag stong du song bar 'gyur te/ g.yon pa'i bcu bzhi pas sdigs mdzub mdzad na/ sdigs mdzub dkyil 'khor la bkod rjes bcu bzhi pa'i lag mgo chad pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ltar phyag thams cad stong par song ba'i skyon med de/ phyag rnams kyis kyang phyag mtshan de rnams 'dzin/ dkyil 'khor la yang phyag mtshan de dang 'dra ba re 'god pa yin snyam na/ 'o na g.yon pa'i bcu bzhi pa rang gi sdigs mdzub mdzad kyang / de dang 'dra ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i phyag mgo gcig la dkyil 'khor la bri ba ji ltar 'gal/ gzhan yang de 'dra'i rigs can mtha' yas kyang / dgag sgrub rgyas par ni ngag las shes dgos so/ /de dag gis ni gung ru shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam la dgag bsgrub kyi spros pa bye brag tu bshad pa bstan zin nas//

༈ //da ni 'phros don gyi legs bshad gnyis pa chos rje byams pa chos legs kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyis rje mus chen sems dpa' chen po yab sras kyi gsung bzhin du bshad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i dbu na bzhugs pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi dam pa'i chos byung tshul dgag bsgrub dang bcas pa legs par bshad pa'i gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgrub pa'i thabs zab mo bshad pa la/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos/ de 'chad par byed pa'i man ngag des bshad pa ltar nyams su blang ba/ nyams su blangs pa las thob pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po/ bshad bya'i chos ngos bzung ba dang / de khyad par 'phags pa bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi bka' stsal pa'i/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud gnyis kyi/ pha rgyud la/ skye bo 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/ gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gtso bor bstan pa gshin rje gshed kyi skor ro/ /phyi ma la dmar nag gnyis/ nag po'i skor ni/ dang po ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya kha'i tshe/ srod la bdud thams cad kyi 'tshe ba rab tu mang po byung ba la/ thugs ka nas khro bo dgra nag sprul te/ phyag na rdo rje la/ phyag na rdo rje khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs su bsgyur te/ bdud dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / lha rnams choms shig chings shig rtogs shig ces gsungs/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes dgra nag gi tshogs mang por sprul te/ bdud rnams btul/

de'i tshe phyag na rdo rje sogs gdul bya skal ldan rnams la rtsa rgyud dgra nag le'u bco brgyad pa/ de'i bshad rgyud la/ cho ga'i rnam gzhag ma tshang ba kha skong bar byed pa gdong drug drag las mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pa rtog bdun te/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum gsungs/ gzhan dag rgyud du 'dod pa'i rtog gsum ni/ man ngag dang ldan pa gcig gis byas pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag 'dug la/ rtog gcig ma/ 'khor lo'i rtog pa/ gshin rje brang dmar gyi rtog pa sogs ni/ skyo lugs pa'i sngags pa kha cig gis rang dgar brtsams pa yin zhing / las mkhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa'i man ngag gcig rwa lugs pa kha cig zur du phyung ba yin gyi rgyud rang dga' ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs gtso bor 'di ltar gsungs te/ 'jam dpal khri drug stong pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi le'u drug pa/ 'jam dpal klu dbyangs kyi le'u zur du phyung ba ni 'jam dpal mtshan brjod yin la/ 'jam dpal ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i yang dag pa'i ye shes la zer zhing / de'i mtshan yang mi gsal ba la byings che ba'i tshul gyis bstan te/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /zhes sogs kyis chos sku'i mtshan bstan/ shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /zhes sogs kyis longs sku'i mtshan bstan/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces sogs kyis sprul sku'i mtshan bstan/ de'i yang / rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces gsungs pa de bshad pa la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'bum pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /zhes gsungs pa de bshad pa la gdong drug gi rgyud/ mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bshad pa la dgra nag gi rgyud gsungs so/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rgyas par/ dang por 'jigs byed zhi ba'i cha lugs can bstan pa'i rjes su/

'jigs byed drag po ston byed rtog pa bdun yod pa de/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ras zur du phyung ba ni rtog bdun yin la/ de nas bshad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs ni 'dir bshad bya'i chos so/ /gnyis pa la/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud du bsgrub pa/ rgyud rnams kyi mthar thug tu bsgrub pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor zab par bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor rnams bla med du grub ste/ de dag las/ dbang bzhi dang lam rim pa gnyis bstan pas so/ /dang po yang / dgra nag las/ cod pan dbang bskur dang po ste/ /ral gri dbang bskur gnyis pa yin/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sbyor ba/ /zla ba btung ba bzhi pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ de'i tshig rkang dngos rigs pa'i dbang lnga bstan te/ cod pan gyi dbang zhes pa/ tsar tsi ka sogs yum lnga'i cod pan/ rnam snang sogs rigs lnga yin pas/ rigs lnga'i dbang bskur zhes pa'i don yin pas so/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan te/ ral gris pha rol gyi dngos po gcod par ltar/ rdo rjes nyon mongs pa gcod pas/ rdo rje la ral gris ming gis btags te bstan to/ /gsum pas slob dpon gyi dbang bstan te/ rdo rje zhes pas/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu zhes pas dril bu gsung gi dam tshig rab sbyor zhes pas phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor pas phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig bstan pas so/ /bzhi pas gsang dbang bstan te/ zla ba btung ba de slob dpon yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pas byang sems slob ma'i lce thog tu 'jog pa yin pas so/ /rgyal mtshan can gyi 'khyams mthong nas/ /de nas 'o ma bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pas dbang gsum pa bstan to/ /rgyal mtshan can ni gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa po/ 'khyam mthong na zhes pa bde ba sgrub pa'i rten las kyi phyag rgya/ 'o ma bsgrub par bya zhes pa de snyoms 'jug byas nas byang sems dbab bzung bzlog khyab pa la sogs pas 'dzin pa yin pas so/

/dbang gsum pa bstan pas bzhi pa yod par shugs la grub la/ dbang bzhi bstan pas rim gnyis yod par yang grub cing / rim gnyis bstan par 'og nas kyang shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud gzhan las/ 'phrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud 'di nyid 'phrul 'khor gyi sgo nas rgyud gzhan las mthar thug pa yin te/ rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i 'phrul 'khor la brten nas las tshogs chung ngus myur du bsgrub nus kyi/ rgyud gzhan la brten nas de ltar bsgrub mi nus pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ /khyad par 'phags zhes lung las byung / /gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la gnang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di la bskyed chog gi sgo nas khyad par 'phags par bsgrub pa dang / lha'i rnam pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags par bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang bskyed chog gi khyad par 'phags par bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po'i lus sems gnyis las/ sems la gtso bor bar du gcod byed ni/ nges don gyi gshin rje bdag 'dzin dang / de kho na nyid las 'bras dang bcas pa la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa yin la/ de 'jam dpal du bskyed pas 'joms te/ ye shes tshogs bsag gi skabs su/ bdag 'dzin ma rig pa dang bcas pa/ bdag med dam gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab bde chen gyi ye shes chos sku'i ngo bor bsgyur te/ de las longs skur langs pa'i tshe shes rab kyi lha rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par shar ba yin pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa po'i lus rgyun brtan pa la bar du gcod byed ni/ drang don gyi gshin rje 'chi bdag yin la/ de sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed du bskyed pas 'joms te/ shin tu gdug pa che ba'i gshin rje 'khor bcas 'dul ba'i phyir du rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs rje chen pos khro bo'i nang nas kyang shin tu 'jigs pa ma he'i gdong can gyi skur sprul pas so/

/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku ni mthong ba tsam gyis kyang khro bo rab tu 'jigs pa gzhan thams cad skrag par 'gyur na 'chi bdag lta bu shin tu nas kyang skrag par 'gyur te/ pra khog slang gi rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ni/ /khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje gshed/ /'di mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan/ /thams cad thams cad lag cha 'chor/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /spyir yang drag pos 'dul dgos pa rnams la sems snying rje'i dbang gis rnam pa khro bor bstan dgos te/ drag pos 'dul bar gyur pa la/ /zhi bas nye bar mi sbyor te/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can gyis ni/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'chang 'dis gshin rje 'dul tshul ni/ zhabs bcu drug gis gshin rje'i lcags mkhar bcu drug bsgyel zhing / mtshan ma gyen du langs pas/ re mig dbus ma bcom ste gshin rje 'khor bcas btul bas/ de rnams kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa po la chos sgrub pa'i grogs byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lha'i rnam pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags par bsgrub pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong can/ dbu dgu phyag so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa'i lha'i rnam pa 'di nyid/ lha'i rnam pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags te/ 'dis gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rnam dag gi sgo nas mtshon nus pas so/ /'di zhib par 'og nas ston to// ༈ //gsum pa la/ 'phags yul du ji ltar byung tshul/ gangs can du ji ltar byung tshul/ rang lugs yid ches pa'i brgyud tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gshin rje gshed skor gzhan rnams logs su shes dgos/ rtog bdun la/ mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa/ gzhon nu zla ba'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje grub pa'i 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi gzhung la/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mang po yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/

bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ bod kyi rgyal po'i zhang rigs cog gru shes rab bla mas rgya gar du phyin te/ grub chen a mo gha badz+ra chung ba la/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka'/ rgyud gsum la man ngag gi bshad bka'/ dkyil chog gshin rje gshed 'byung ba/ dgra gdong gnyis kyi sgrub thabs dang 'jigs byed la grub chen la li ta'i sgrub thabs kyi steng nas gsan te/ de nas skyo ba sogs la brgyud nas bod du dar bar mdzad/ zhang gi slob ma skyo jo sras kyis kyang / grub chen a mo gha chung ba la/ bdag la bla ma rang gi yi dam thugs rtsis che ba gcig gi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa thugs la 'dogs dgos zhes zhus pas/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad bsrung ba la shin tu sngags shing nga'i yi dam gyi mthil yang 'di yin gsungs nas/ 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gnang / de'i ye shes dbab pa'i dus/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od rdza ma tsam zhig byung nas/ slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam yod pa thams cad kyi mgo thog na phar yar 'gro mar 'gro byas te/ mthar skyo jo sras kyi thugs kar thim/ de nas khong la skyo 'od 'byung du grags/ bla mas khong la dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ sems dpa' bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs sogs gnang / de nas 'jigs byed skyo lugs zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa de dar ro/ /yang rje btsun 'brog gis dz+nyā na a ka ra'i sgrub thabs bsgyur/ 'gos kyis slob dpon shrī bha dra'i sgrub thabs bsgyur/ de gnyis nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed kyi chos skor byung yang da lta chad nas med/ yang gnyos lo tsā ba rgya gar du byon te/ paṇ+ḍi ta bha ling ta ā tsar+ya la kha chod che ba mdo sngags thams cad kyi dgongs par song ba gsang sngags yin pa gcig gnang bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gnang / dgon pa bsrung ba'i chos skyong gcig dgos zhus pas/ traka shad gnang / chos skyong 'di rtsub po rang zhig yod pa 'dra/

'di gnon pa'i yi dam khro bo gcig gnang dgos zhus pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dang de'i zhor la dgra gdong gnyis kyang gnang ste bod du 'jigs byed gnyos lugs zhes bya ba byung ngo / /yang bla ma mal nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed sogs byung tshul 'og nas ston/ yang rwa lo tsā bas bal por byon te/ bla ma bha ro phyag rdum la dgra gdong 'jigs gsum mkhas par bslabs/ de'i tshe rong ban chen pos rong du spyan drangs te gshin rje gshed skor rnams shin tu dar bar mdzad/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum la sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka bka' 'grel man ngag gi shog gril sogs dkar chag tu btab pa ltar yig cha mang du mdzad do/ /gsum pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ye shes zhabs la/ des grub chen dpal 'dzin la gnang / grub chen gyis dgra nag gi 'grel pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil chog dgra nag la sgrub thabs rnams mdzad/ rgyud gzhan gnyis la 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa/ sgrub thabs kyang rgyud kyi steng nas man ngag gis bton nas mdzad/ des rje btsun nā ro ta pa sogs la rim par brgyud/ de nas mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po la gnang / sa chen gyis rtog bdun la ṭīk+ka dang mchan mdzad/ de nas rje btsun sku mched la brgyud de/ rje btsun gnyis kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa re mdzad/ de nas gan pa sogs la brgyud de/ dbang bka' bshad bka' sogs khungs btsun par yod pa/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga'i mtshan can gyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de nas de'i sras kyi thu bo/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa rje btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i mtshan can gyis dbang bka' lung bka' bshad bka' rnams legs par gnang / sgrub thabs la rnam bshad kyi rtsom yang mdzad de shin tu dar bar mdzad/

de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ges sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog gnyis mdzad la/ yang bdag gi bla ma dam pa rje btsun sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'i mtshan can gyis dbang lung bshad pa sogs rgya cher mdzad/ sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog gtor chog bkra shis rnams kyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad de legs par dar rgyas su mdzad/ gzhan yang lung 'di'i phyag len bshad pa sogs kyi dpe mang du yod do/ /gsum pa bshad pa ltar nyams su blang tshul la/ rgyud las bstan tshul dang / bstan pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu 'di la rtog pa bdun yod pa'i dang pos/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la smin byed kyi dbang thob dgos pas/ dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ gnyis pas dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa las bsgrub pa sogs kyi ched du yin pas/ 'phrul 'khor gyi sgo nas las bsgrub tshul bstan/ las bsgrub pa la sngags dag po'i bsnyen pa tshad du 'gro dgos pas/ gsum pas sngags btu bsnyen tshad dang bcas pa bstan/ sngags kyang tha mal pas rang dgar bzlas pas mi chog gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bzla dgos pas/ bzhi pas lha bsgom tshul bstan/ gang zag tha mas lha la dmigs pa gsal po ma byung na/ bris sku la bltas te gsal btab dgos pas/ lnga pas bris sku 'bri tshul bstan/ lha'i rnal 'byor can gyi bzlas pa'i sngags kyis nus pa dbyung ba dang / bsgrub pa la yang sbyin sreg dgos pas/ drug pas sbyin sreg bstan/ dbang po rab kyis 'phrul 'khor sbyin sreg la ma ltos par bsam gtan tsam gyis las bsgrub pas/ bdun pas bsam gtan gyi las bsgrub tshul bstan to/ /rgyud don 'di rnams gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi nyams len du bsgrigs na/ dbang thob nas lha bsgom ste sngags bzla ba gang zag gsum ga la dgos pas/ dbang lha bsgom pa sngags bzla ba gsum ga gang zag gsum ga'i nyams len thun mong ba/

ras bris la brten nas sems 'dzin pa dbang po tha ma'i nyams len/ sbyin sreg dang 'phrul 'khor ni/ gang zag tha mas gnyis ka la brten dgos shing / 'bring gis gang rung la brten pa'i chog pas/ 'bring tha ma'i thun mong ba/ rab kyis bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub pas/ bsam gtan rab kyi nyams len no/ /gnyis pa la/ spyir sgrub thabs kyi rnam gzhag ji ltar yod tshul/ de la mi 'thad pa'i phyogs dgag pa/ rang lugs kyi sgrub thabs gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa dang / dpa' bo gcig pa ji ltar yod tshul gnyis/ /dang po ni/ grub chen la li tas/ zhi khro rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba gzhal yas khang le dgu lha snam rim pa gcig dang bcas pa'i nang du/ ro dang / phyag mtshan so gnyis/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gyi 'og gi srog chags bcu drug rnams lha sku mdog nag po/ ma he'i gdong can zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mgo sogs rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa ste lha zhe dgu ma gcig bshad/ grub chen a mo gha badz+ras/ sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes pa/ srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsibs brgyad la/ ma ba ti sogs gshin rje pho brgyad/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du gshin rje pho nya ma sogs mo brgyad bkod pa'i dbus su gtso bo ste lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs gcig bshad/ slob dpon a phos/ lha dgu bdag mdun gnyis ka la bskyed pa'i sgrub thabs gcig mdzad/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel par/ nag po srin po lta bu gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa'i ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig bshad/ sa skya pa chen po yang ro langs chen po brgyad sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro bo'i gdong can g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin par bzhed/ zhes gsung bgros 'ga' zhig las 'byung yang / bla dpe'i mchan las ro langs rang gi mgo lag tu thogs nas gar byed par bshad la/ de yang gtso bo'i zhal dgu po lha dgu'i rnam par shar ba yin te/

'jam dpal gyi zhal gtso bo dang / khro zhal brgyad ro langs kyi rnam par shar ba'i phyir/ bstod par yang / lha dgu'i rang bzhin zhal dgu'i nyams ldan zhing / /zhes gsungs pas so/ rwa pa rnams ro langs chen po brgyad/ kha dog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sbar ba gyen du bgrad pa/ g.yon thur du bgrad pa/ ro langs kyi sgrub thabs byed na/ ro langs rnams mgo bo/ khog pa/ lag pa/ rkang pa rnams gsum gsum par bzhed do/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs la/ gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa/ srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa/ de rnams med pa'i pad nyi'i steng du bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa dang gsum/ dang po la rten dang brten pa rim can du bskyed pa/ dz+nyā na a ka ra zhi ba ye shes la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs cig car du bskyed pa/ shrī bha dra'i sgrub thabs/ sa skya pa'i lugs la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs/ rwa lo'i zhal dgu rin chen sgron ma'o/ /gsum pa ni/ grub chen a mo ghas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /gzhan yang bod 'ga' zhig gis byas pa'i phyag mtshan rnams dang / zhabs g.yas kyi 'og gi srog chags brgyad lhar bskyed pa lha zhe gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dang / yang srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsibs brgyad la gshin rje brgyad/ dngos gzhi'i dus su gtso bo la ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lugs dang / yang srung 'khor gyi rtsibs bcu la khro bo bcu dang / gzhal yas khang du dpa' bo gcig pa bsgoms nas/ re mig rnams la phyag mtshan mi 'god pa'i lugs dang / yang slob dpon rnam snang srung bas mdzad zer ba'i lha lnga ma dang / yang rwa lo tsā bas bal po thugs rje chen po'i man ngag yin zer ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la dgra nag gi 'khor gyis bskor ba lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad/

gnyos pas bha ling ta a tsar+ya'i man ngag yin zer ba'i dgra nag gi sgo ba bzhi med pa'i lha dgu ma gcig mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha zhe gcig ma nas lha lnga ma'i bar mi 'thad de/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub 'di'i dgongs pa yin ngos bzung med pa'i rang bzor nges pa'o/ /lugs phyi ma gnyis ni the tshom gyi gzhi yin te/ de ltar ston byed kyi rgyud rgya gzhung tshad ldan yod na rigs na yang de ltar ston byed med pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir kyai rdo rje sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams kyi dkyil 'khor lta bu gtso bo mi 'dra ba 'khor 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de ltar ston byed kyi rgyud rgya gzhung rnam dag yod pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la kha cig na re/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma la rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi khungs med zer ba mi 'thad de/ bshad rgyud rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi rtog pa las/ le dgu dang de'i phyi rol du re mig bcu gnyis la/ ya k+ṣe ma me sogs yi ge bcu bdun 'god par bshad la/ dgra nag las/ yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces sogs gsungs nas yi ge bcu bdun lha bcu gsum dang thod pa bzhi ru gsungs shing / 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi lha bcu gsum gyi las bsgrub pa'i skabs su gtso bo la gshin rje gshed gzhan yong don med pa'i phyir dang / 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas las bsgrub pa'i skabs su yi ge bcu bdun lha'i rnam pa bcu gsum dang lha'i ngo bo thod pa bzhir bskyed par/ dpal chen rdo rje grub pas/ yi ge bcu bdun de dag lha bcu bdun gyi rang bzhin du rnam par bsgoms la/ zhes sogs gsungs pas kyang bstan pa'i phyir/ des na rdo rje'i 'jigs byed la dgra nag gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i lha bcu gsum ma yod pa shin du gsal bas/ gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags dang / rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bod du srol phye ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma 'di shin du legs pas skur pa gdab par mi bya'o/

/zhes sogs mang du bris so/ /de yang khong rang gi lugs kyi rigs lung man ngag gi sgrub byed gsum du byed par 'dug pas/ rigs pa'i sgrub byed mi 'thad de/ rtog gsum bshad rgyud ma yin zhing / rwa lo sogs kyang bshad rgyud du khas mi len pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rdo rje 'jigs byed la dbyug pa dang / tho ba 'dzin pa'i gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs gshed dmar gyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i lha bcu gsum ma gcig byed rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor du ya k+ṣe sogs yi ge bcu bdun bshad la/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud dang / yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces sogs kyis yi ge bcu bdun lhar bskyed par bshad cing / 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi las sgrub pa'i skabs su/ gtso bo la gshin rje gshed gzhan yong don med pa'i phyir/ yang rdo rje 'jigs byed la 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs gdong drug gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig kyang rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor du ya sogs yi ge bcu bdun bshad la/ gdong drug gi rgyud du/ yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces sogs kyi yi ge bcu bdun lhar bskyed par bshad pa sogs kyi phyir/ yang rdo rje 'jigs byed de la phyogs skyong bco lngas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig kyang rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor du hriḥsogs yi ge bco lnga 'god par bshad la/ dgra nag tu yi ge bco lnga las phyogs skyong bco lnga bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ gsal pa'ang khas len no/ /yang rdo rje 'jigs byed la bdag med lha mo bco lngas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor yang rigs par 'gyur te/ rtog gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor du/ a li bcu drug 'god par bshad la/ brtag gnyis las/ a li dang po bdag med ma/ /zhes sogs kyis a li dang po bco lnga las/

bdag med lha mo bco lnga bskyed par bshad pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /gzhan yang khyed kyi sgrub byed de la 'brel cung zad kyang med de/ 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs su bkod pa'i yi ge yin na lha'i rnam par bskyed pas ma khyab cing / dgra nag gi yi ge k+ṣe ni gti mug brjod/ /ces sogs kyi yi ge rnams ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs kyi lha'i sa bon yin pas/ de gnyis phyogs mi gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po yi ge'i rnam pas brtson srung gi tshul du bkod/ ces gsungs pa dang / khyed rang gis kyang khas blangs so/ /lung gi sgrub byed dang 'khrul te/ 'grel pa der yi ge bcu bdun lha bcu bdun gyi rnam par bsgom par bshad kyi/ yi ge bcu bdun po lha bcu gsum du bsgom zhes ma bshad pas so/ /yin phyogs ni/ yi ge bcu bdun po de/ a mo gha badz+ra gyis bzhed pa'i lha bcu bdun por bsgom rgyu yin no/ /man ngag gi sgrub byed kyang 'khrul te/ gnyos pa'i lugs la lha bcu gsum ma med cing / rwa los lha bcu gsum ma bshad kyang bris sku la yum mi 'dod do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la phyag mtshan 'god par bshad pas/ khyod kyi lugs kyang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang khyed kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod par bshad pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ de la sgrub byed med cing gnod byed yod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sgrub byed med pa ma grub ste/ sgrub byed gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de'i dang po dbang gong ma gnyis la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ gtso bo la yum yod de 'jigs byed la dbang gnyis pa dang gsum pa yod la/ gsang dbang gi skabs su bla ma rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed nas yum la brten te gsang dbang gi rdzas bsgrub dgos/ dbang gsum pa la slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed pa/ rig ma lha mor bskyed pa snyoms par zhugs pas/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bo bskyed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yum med pa dang / sta gon gyi skabs su nang dbang bskur ba yang 'gal ba yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la brten nas sgrub bo/ /gsum pa kyai rdo rje la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ 'jigs byed la yum bsgom pa med na bskyed rim gyi gnad ma tshang bar 'gyur te/ bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo rdzogs rim gyi rtog pa khyad par can skye ba'i rgyu smin byed du 'gro ba yin la/ de la bskyed rim gyi skabs su yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas drangs pa'i bde ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi lta ba gnyis sbyar te rgyun ldan du bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i dogs dpyod brtag gnyis kyi bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs las gsal bar gsungs te/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /zhes sogs kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dngos grub thob par bshad pa la/ 'o na bdag med ma gtso bor byas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis phyag rgya'i dngos grub ji ltar thob par 'gyur te/ rig ma bsgom pa med par phyag rgya'i dngos grub mi thob la/ phyag rgya gnyis sbyar bas bde chen mi skye ba'i phyir/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bdag med mas mdzad pa la bsgom pa'i tshe/ mo'i rtags bsgyur nas pho rtags dang ldan par bsgom par bshad la/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lha pho gcig tu bshad pa la yang sngar gyi dogs pa de nges par skye/ de dpyod pa la yum yod pa'i lan btab dgos pas so zhes smras so/ /de rnams rim pa bzhin du mi 'thad de/ phreng bar gsungs pa'i phag mo lha sum cu rtsa bdun ma/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun/ ye shes mkha' 'gro sogs yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi bskyed rim bsgom dus gtso mo la yab sbyar dgos par 'gyur ba dang /
