phreng bar bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la yang bskyed rim gyi skabs su yum sbyar dgos par 'gyur te/ de rnams la dbang gong ma bskur ba yod pas so/ /'dod na bla med kyi yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor mi srid par 'gyur ba dang / a bhas/ bcom ldan 'das ni shes rab ma dang bral ba'o/ /zhes pa dang 'gal/ de nas yab rkyang dang yum rkyang gi dkyil 'khor nang dbang dang dbang gong ma gnyis bskur dgos rnams ni/ rang rang gi gtso bo'i rigs bdag yab yum gyis bskur ba'i phyag len/ rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar la rgyun ma chad par yod do/ /yang yab yum rkyang pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms kyang rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin byed du 'gyur mi srid par thal te/ rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin byed kyi bskyed rim yin la/ yab yum zhal sbyor du bsgom pas drangs ba'i bde ba dang ldan dgos pas so/ /'dir ni mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas bskyed pa dang / liṅga gyen du langs pa sogs rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi rigs pas mi 'grub ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ma bshad pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis kyi lung gis kyang mi 'grub ste/ lung des nyer rgyus mtshams sbyor ran pa'i bdag med ma'i sgrub po bud med gcig rang dang rtogs pa mnyam pa'i byang sems sa bcu pa ma rnyed na pho'i gzugs su dngos su gyur nas phyag rgya ma gzhan dang snyoms par zhugs nas mtshams sbyor zhes ston pa yin gyi/ las dang po pa'i dus su bskyed rim bsgom pa'i tshe/ bud med kyi gzugs su bsgom pa spangs nas/ he ru ka'i gzugs su bsgom par ston pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ 'bad pa med par skyes bur 'gyur/ /gsal bar nus pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de phyir phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/des na rdo rje 'jigs byed la yum yod pa la sgrub byed med par ma zad gnod byed kyang yod do/ /khyed 'dod pa ltar gyi yum rdo rje ro langs ma de lta bu gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir/ dgra nag nas gsungs pa de 'dir len no snyam na/ de'i tshig gi cha len nam don gyi cha len pa yin/ dang po ltar na/ der rang 'dra'i yum zhes bshad pas/ 'dir yum zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa cig byed rigs par 'gyur/ gnyis pa ltar na/ yum zhal gsum phyag drug pa cig byed rigs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gshed dmar nas bshad pa 'dir len no snyam na/ de ltar na dmar mo cig byed rigs par 'gyur ro/ /des na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ston pa'i rgyud rgya gzhung thams cad las liṅga dmar po gyen du langs par bshad pa de la/ khyed kyis thugs kyis ma bzod par yum cig cis kyang dgos par 'dug snyam nas sbyar ba yin mod kyi liṅga gyen du langs par bshad pa kho nas kyang yum med par bstan te/ yum yod na liṅga yum gyi pad+mar nub pas/ phyi rol du gyen la langs pa'i bshad pa yong don med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa de dag gis ni khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam sprul sems dpa' che/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa gang de sras bcas kyis/ /dus gsum bstan dang 'gro la phan mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i mdzad 'phrin 'di ngo mtshar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ de ltar bdud dgra gshin rje gshed dpal gyis/

/zab yangs dam chos rin chen byung ba'i tshul/ /legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos yid 'ong 'di/ /skal ldan blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston mdzod/ 1 /'di sbyar dge bas dmar nag 'jigs gsum chos/ /'di mthong rkyen gyis thob 'dod cher skyes nas/ /'di nang bshad bzhin yongs rdzogs legs nos te/ /'di dang lhan cig phyogs kun 'phel gyur cig 2 /e ma sngon tshe dus kyi skal bzang rnams/ /rtag tu dam chos 'tshol bas brel zhes thos/ /kye ma da ni zab chos 'di longs zhes/ /lan brgyar smras kyang don gnyer re re tsam/ 3 /de lta na yang gong ma'i rnam thar mchog /de 'dra'i rjes su slob pa cher 'dod nas/ /de lta'i skyes chen rnams kyi gsung rab tshogs/ /de dag legs par bltas nas tshul 'di brtsams/ 4 /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs/ /sgrib med gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa 'di dgongs la/ bstan pa 'phel phyir don kun 'grub par mdzod/ 5 /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsod nams kyis/ bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe mthar phyin zhing dus phyi mar/ /mkha' 'gros mkha' spyod grong du 'khrid gyur cig 6 /ces dpal gshin rje gshed mar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin po che'i lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa chen po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan la sogs te/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid/ rang sems dag pa'i dbyings su ro gcig pa'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs gang de dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs su rang ngo shes pa'i theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

me pho stag lo zla ba gsum pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan chen po dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub dang / smon 'gro pa ngag dbang chos 'phel gyis bgyis pa 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /ming gzhan gdod nas rang grol zhes bya ba'i/ /gsung rab don la spyod pa'i mig yangs pa/ /skal bzang gos dkar lcang lo can des so/ ka l+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu/ thams cad bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi chos 'byung legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
